name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Solidarity means showing up.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
If the working class doesn't stand up for itself, no one else will.
#
For 10 days, the United Auto Workers have been on strike as they negotiate for better wages and conditions for 150,000 workers across the country.
**And since Day 1, Alexandria, Rep. Cori Bush, and Rep. Rashida Tlaib have stood in proud support of these striking auto workers** , and workers everywhere, as they push for a contract that reflects their value — yesterday, Alexandria even joined Cori in Wentzville, MO to rally with UAW.
**Alexandria, Cori, and Rashida came to Congress to fight for working people against corporate greed** , for a future where every single worker makes a living wage and doesn’t have to choose between putting food on the table and paying their bills.
[If that is a future you are willing to fight for, will you split a $5 contribution between Alexandria, Cori, and Rashida today? Every single contribution helps keep our progressive movement strong by powering the re-elections of these three champions for working people. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230925.eX0cwB&refcode=em20230925-5042-P_FND_EGR_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5042%2E2526796%2E041KEB)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230925.eX0cwB&refcode=em20230925-5042-P_FND_EGR_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5042%2E2526796%2E041KEB)**
Ford, General Motors, and Stellantis — or “The Big 3” — have netted nearly a quarter trillion dollars in profit over the last decade. And while their CEOs have given themselves raises of 40%, **UAW wages have only increased by 6%.**
This fight comes at a time when the average salary of a working-class American is lower than it was 30 years ago — while corporations report record-breaking profits.
And while CEO’s complain that fair pay for workers is ‘unsustainable’, Alexandria, Cori, and Rashida have made it clear: there’s no way corporations can spend hundreds of millions of dollar on stock buybacks to manipulate prices and boost their own pay to ludicrous levels, while starving the workers who make the products they sell. **Workers deserve dignified pay.**
[Will you split a $5 contribution between Alexandria, Cori, and Rashida’s campaigns today so that they can keep standing up for working families?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230925.eX0cwB&refcode=em20230925-5042-P_FND_EGR_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5042%2E2526796%2E041KEB)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230925.eX0cwB&refcode=em20230925-5042-P_FND_EGR_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=5042%2E2526796%2E041KEB)**
Every dollar, no matter the amount, shows widespread support for our progressive movement from NY-14 and beyond.
Solidarity always,
Team AOC

| | | Peter, After nearly 146 days on strike, the Writers Guild of America has won a tentative agreement with the Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers! While the agreement language isn’t public yet, the WGA Negotiating Committee told their members:
> “We can say, with great pride, that this deal is exceptional – with meaningful gains and protections for writers in every sector of the membership.” — WGA Negotiating Committee
**This is a huge victory months in the making, but the fight isn’t over yet — actors with SAG-AFTRA are still on strike, and until the AMPTP is willing to make a fair deal with them, many actors, writers, and crew members will continue to be out of work.** **[To help entertainment workers who are struggling during these strikes and to ensure that union actors have the leverage needed to win a fair contract of their own, can you help us support the Union Solidarity Fund today? Your contribution of any amount will show solidarity with workers across the country as their fights continue.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wsThlG7hrLBzJ5LlmLpqbNZw6g9r_xtA2ZmNgG52zd-_tbelbzBc5WnhMtroyBPdXOjNh9Na165I-_Pxg9x2qDwVmuJXxawH6z1uKxl_cyXtNKT_HvSJL_6MF0tV7uh6aQ5ZhCy1k00D4SwHtyLnMvECkHFHWs_0d1uzCOVTexJdZCG-H_VdjAFPYsyToHabMwwLkUXvIClyxmAaNNwirKYxWrRC87MrMeW9wPchMYt5xAcTRrUoka8PFth0mzGv8lxaK1eyYvyQ3-ptH5jwfRA3PotUpFUKnZvMJuPJxgxiD28nGZt26S2d_AWfig3gOTksPElM2ipECMIBQ3B7F2dujnHI4tX3liTjMPsT9SJQ/3zx/CpG-56PtSTG6YGX_QvB_Eg/h0/UqmJ_MOKbLBk8oZ_uMxfGn409_nOm1UYmpIVMj7yg2U)** **[Support the Union Solidarity Fund](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wsThlG7hrLBzJ5LlmLpqbNZw6g9r_xtA2ZmNgG52zd-_tbelbzBc5WnhMtroyBPdXOjNh9Na165I-_Pxg9x2qDOCzILqx45T7tZOPxWP8I6j580-OqOYKmxDsunRA-5pBs4VMQdGAKRL8tfbE-C4h8-hbtYQq8Zek7mR-ySdLjhiQidnKqzMJCq0QRIn-OrdJbjuDPfv71oR4bAIBOEglMqtcYRwukQs2MflNOoXARZG8R_pemmnOjE9xsD1LLAiTYd-APRlkqFc4hoNVaC3ZhGNJHTpKtMiH8lZm5PYQb8pyiDbut81YHRcnKC8MPIXHRgiAuIOCuUR-uVeHHbB2gxQ1WIDYjGvKfMVyvYoDqUA/3zx/CpG-56PtSTG6YGX_QvB_Eg/h1/VLu5PCwrBfi26rhGWV9pAhYFtgvNXkNXi2yknmIhK-I)** Now that a tentative agreement has been reached, here are the next steps to getting this contract ratified: First, the WGA Negotiating Committee will decide whether to take the final language to the WGA West Board and WGA East Council for a vote. Then, if those committees agree, the full contract will be released to the public, and the union’s 11,000 members will vote on whether or not to ratify the deal. In the meantime, the WGA has suspended its own picketing, but in a show of worker solidarity they are encouraging members to join SAG-AFTRA’s picket lines as they continue to fight for their own deal. **Strikes aren’t easy for workers, who are risking their livelihoods, medical benefits, and so much more to take a stand against some of our nation’s wealthiest and most powerful corporations. But as powerful as these companies are, the fact of the matter is that when we stand together, we are even stronger.** The unions who have organized and gone on strike against massive studios and streamers, major automotive companies, Amazon, Starbucks, UPS, and so much more fight this fight for all of us, to build an economy and a country that work for the many, not the few. clean_body: | | | Peter, After nearly 146 days on strike, the Writers Guild of America has won a tentative agreement with the Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers! While the agreement language isn’t public yet, the WGA Negotiating Committee told their members: “We can say, with great pride, that this deal is exceptional – with meaningful gains and protections for writers in every sector of the membership.” — WGA Negotiating Committee This is a huge victory months in the making, but the fight isn’t over yet — actors with SAG-AFTRA are still on strike, and until the AMPTP is willing to make a fair deal with them, many actors, writers, and crew members will continue to be out of work. Now that a tentative agreement has been reached, here are the next steps to getting this contract ratified: First, the WGA Negotiating Committee will decide whether to take the final language to the WGA West Board and WGA East Council for a vote. Then, if those committees agree, the full contract will be released to the public, and the union’s 11,000 members will vote on whether or not to ratify the deal. In the meantime, the WGA has suspended its own picketing, but in a show of worker solidarity they are encouraging members to join SAG-AFTRA’s picket lines as they continue to fight for their own deal. Strikes aren’t easy for workers, who are risking their livelihoods, medical benefits, and so much more to take a stand against some of our nation’s wealthiest and most powerful corporations. But as powerful as these companies are, the fact of the matter is that when we stand together, we are even stronger. The unions who have organized and gone on strike against massive studios and streamers, major automotive companies, Amazon, Starbucks, UPS, and so much more fight this fight for all of us, to build an economy and a country that work for the many, not the few. As we celebrate the WGA’s victory, we maintain our solidarity with SAG-AFTRA, the United Auto Workers, and all other workers taking a stand in order to be treated fairly and compensated for the value that they provide. clean_body: | Peter, Happy Hispanic Heritage Month! This month, we celebrate our Latino culture and honor the incredible contributions made by Latino Americans in the United States. Celebrating our Hispanic heritage also means recognizing the sacrifices of the generations before us, who came to the U.S. in search of the American dream. For me, it’s my mom and abuela. For you, it could be a parent, a best friend, a neighbor down the street. But for all of us, Latino representation in Congress isn’t just a nice idea – it’s a critical priority. ~~ My abuela, my mom, and my aunt came from Cuba during the freedom flights in the late 1960s. They had no money, and didn’t speak English. My abuela worked multiple factory jobs for little pay in harsh working conditions, just so my mom and aunt would have a shot at a better life for themselves and their future families. Because of their sacrifices, I was able to live out the American dream and become the first Gen Z and Afro-Cuban member of Congress. I’m proud to be a part of one of the most diverse classes of Congress in history, with a record number of Latinos serving right now. But there’s a lot more progress to be made. We need to ensure that our Hispanic heritage stays represented in Congress, so we can ALL achieve the American dream.** ~~ | | | ~~ ~~ | ~~ ~ | ~ Juntos, Maxwell Alejandro Frost ~~ ~ | PAID FOR BY MAXWELL FROST FOR CONGRESS Maxwell Frost for Congress PO Box 772671 Orlando, FL 32877-2671 United States | Maxwell is an organizer representing Florida's 10th Congressional District in Congress. Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.

body:

| |

| |
# Party of the Constitution
---
Dear Attendees of the 35th Biennial Mackinac Republican Leadership Conference,
On behalf of our team, who worked diligently to ensure that you had an unforgettable experience, creating lifelong memories, we want to say THANK YOU.
This year's conference featured speakers committed to our theme, that the Republican Party is The Party of the Constitution.
My hope is that you walked away from this year’s conference determined and understanding that we are at an impasse as a nation, and that this fight is Americans vs. Globalists.
**We will be mocked for speaking the truth.**
The Detroit News “journalist” who claim to be Republican mocked us, and want the Republican Party to return to the status quo of managed opposition. What has this status quo gotten us?
With our children's and grandchildren’s future hanging in the balance, we can’t afford the status quo that has infected our party. This has led to Republicans finding virtue in siding with Democrats against Republicans, who stand by our principles, defend our Constitution, and stand by our Republican Party platform.
When bringing massive change to longtime problems, resistance and schisms by those who maintained and benefited from the broken system are to be expected, and should shock or deter no one.
We must ask ourselves about the direction the party has been going for the last 20 years - **have you been happy with it**? Have we been successful at advancing the cause of Constitutionalism? Have we as Conservatives, gained ground or lost?
**Growth can be painful.**
But growth will be necessary if we are going to succeed as a Republican Party in saving our nation.
**Please get involved!**
Start with enrolling in our Good Neighbor Program, and get trained on how to take our nation back by neighborhood team building.
| [SIGN UP TO BE A GOOD NEIGHBOR](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=40cc81f295&e=a2af77507c)
---
Also, please financially support the Michigan Republican Party by signing up for a recurring monthly donation of a minimum of $20/month.
We need your financial support to ensure a successful 2024 election.
To God Be the Glory,
Kristina Karamo
Chairwoman
| [DONATE NOW](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=925a4ac26b&e=a2af77507c)

### SO HELP ME GOD.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Help us stop these unlawful mandates
body:
Friend, I hope you’re paying attention.

| |
---
| | Friend, I hope you’re paying attention. Because after years of inconsistent, unscientific, and ineffective measures to “slow the spread” of COVID-19, the powers that be are trying to bring them back. And we’re fighting to stop that from happening. **[But we need your urgent help in order to win. Will you help us stop more draconian COVID mandates with a tax-deductible donation of $35 or more today?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23281%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KIozPwkUbRh9HsRLgVxFrQ&sysid=1)** Let me explain. **Last week we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians who were fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine.** And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice ahead of this so-called “COVID resurgence.” Dovid was the assistant concertmaster and first violinist, while Chris and Rachel both played the French Horn. These are some of the most talented musicians in the country that were in highly coveted and competitive positions. _Each of them had been in the Symphony for over a decade._ When the Symphony introduced their COVID vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions. Dovid, Chris, and Rachel each held sincere religious beliefs that prohibited from taking the vaccine, and they all filed their exemptions and were willing to take other measures like regularly testing to prove they didn’t have COVID. But just a day after they submitted their exemptions, the Symphony rejected ALL of them and shortly thereafter put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE. Just point illustrate how ridiculous the Symphony’s vaccine mandate really was--patrons, sitting mere feet away from musicians, didn’t have to be vaccinated, but our clients lost their jobs for not taking the vaccine. Even after the Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back. We won’t take this attack on their freedoms lying down, because it’s an attack on your freedoms too. We all saw in the news recently that a public school in Maryland announce it is reinstating its mask mandate. And with _USA Today_ and others reporting the “rise” of COVID infection rates, Americans are rightfully concerned that COVID restrictions could be returning. We cannot allow the North Carolina Symphony to get away with firing musicians for refusing a COVID vaccine. **[That’s why I hope I can count on your generous donation of $35 or more right away to put an end to this while we still can.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23282%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2axjKj2NjendyozDSZ%2fFLw&sysid=1)** Because of your support the Center for American Liberty has already had several victories against government agencies who have tried to enforce draconian COVID restrictions. In fact, we beat Gavin Newsom THREE TIMES at the Supreme Court of the United States. With you behind us, we’re not afraid to defend our liberties against anyone. **[Will you join the fight with a generous donation today and help us beat back unconstitutional COVID mandates one more time?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c23283%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0x7eFj9x2blxJPbqi%2bPRmg&sysid=1)** Time is of the essence, and if you don’t take a stand, Friend, who will? Thank you in advance for your continued support.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
Harmeet K. Dhillon
---
Founder & CEO

|

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Moment to talk?
body:
First, I want to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zoltma9s3kfkedu7sacdfbaop31fjdh0nc3dkvro_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs)
---

Friend,

First, I want to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign's momentum ahead of the second debate in less than ONE WEEK!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zttfd8k31d6pi3j4063ti3reb6m9nl9druaou2no_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum ahead of the second debate in ONE WEEK!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z05u96cqesq4rjvd6mn190ah5eehvs5jo81gh670_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs)
---

I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard-working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zajdt70d4vhqoe79sj1gnr07amuaj4egho0q0p98_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs)
---

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zttk6a7q43onk5kom7s8eq85r8fe4udbric369g0_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs)
---

Most importantly, I am running for president because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, at this very moment in time, **I 'm about to hit a huge campaign milestone - my second Presidential Debate. [It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign before I take the stage.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgqskqvc7bt8tgr4nlmnitk06v99epb633k45ea0_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign before I take the stage.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today and to help me boost my campaign momentum ahead of the debate next week?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrnmbvs9a6pgopoiq5kph06gsdncns80d6pvstg8_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today and to help me boost my campaign momentum ahead of the debate next week?")**
---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zc6droi3nl0b1l126661svo5qcjrsprajh5o2jng_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs)
---
Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help again- starting right now.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcqm1vo4v1n02mtj8v04m3ac80eg750lmnon0iho_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs "I need your help again – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,
---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdk97lkpvfusq14rh3p6pjhco04v8cqplefkveo8_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs)
---
Nikki Haley
---
| | | | |
---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdr5dinm2k1qhg0pcjrdouaiejmkf6nkpnuave50_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs "NikkiHaley_Merch")
---
| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhua0ourumcgrekg601r03r24e9sje686bhlfvf8_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs "Claim Your Mug")
---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3gjs6tb7314hn4n42uvtlgsd7pi2e7p8upmkumg_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z27rf2pbc7st4tpi688tveoe4d8fhffdaivllla0_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj60pb2c1h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: We're suing Biden's Press Secretary
body:
Joe Biden's White House just changed the requirements for a journalist to obtain hard-pass credentials.

| |
---
| | Friend, Joe Biden's White House just changed the requirements for a journalist to obtain hard-pass credentials. The result... ...effectively banning our client, Simon Ateba, and more than 440 reporters from the White House Briefing Room. The White House is sending a loud, clear message: if you don't work for CNN, _The New York Times_ , or another legacy media outlet, and if you refuse to mindlessly lob soft balls to Karine Jean-Pierre about Joe Biden's ice cream du jour, you don't belong in the White House Press Corps. Because this White House doesn't respect the freedom of the press. **[Which is why I'm asking you for an urgent donation of $35 or more today to help fund Simon's lawsuit against the White House and Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f37eadac523e4b5db606ea7eaa416cbb&_e=DIUEYB_AFMCrFxGKDdoR4kJimVcPr67BgmAdSTME4xpqHN3HZfhdeFX6B5hgolQBUFKXobNYsaL-BCwHVp-6uns3ofUvxqtdDpP1EQvjQco8jlA5JDyXrPskAqE7U9vqb7PLNg1G6oAwO7KHGzNwJNA6wuiQQ6P8n51rMEc4OVX0zEcY2qD88uprVrwS1t-ycczZiEJiKp2wszJ0a-p-fbQGoP7xaqDqUFgKMrLKN1_1bjT2ARyKRQHfDYn5K3t2XbflrWoqs0KZ_XM0K79y6Sk97wHTVVqf2zxcs7n5CE8gQsbEcwXv6IlOG-tzIompgfY5_vQWHFFhCEfSBU3O-nTfqkKvJEC1FOhv-9tfF7w4Vy05SrG4xPaC5Eflwmhv)** This White House has a terrible record of censoring journalists whose stories make the White House look bad. We all remember how the Biden Administration pressured "Big Tech" to censor journalists questioning the efficacy of the COVID-19 vaccine. Now, the White House is shifting its attention to our client, Simon Ateba. body:

Hi Friend,

You know as much as I do that our country is headed down the wrong path. The current administration is not the solution.

That's why we need someone who can win.

**Friend, I am that candidate. **

I'm the only one decisively defeating Biden in the polls.

I'm surging in Iowa, New Hampshire, and South Carolina.

We've gained so much ground since the first debate, but we have so much more left to accomplish. _**[That's why I'm asking you to step up with your most generous contribution today.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zlp4opvqsqhpi0uol4qe7du71ds3j6geelo960po_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj6ao32cdh2bs "That’s why I’m asking you to step up with your most generous contribution today. After that I'll be gearing up for more swings across the country, continue to build out our ground game in early voting states, and do everything in my power to win the first-in-the-nation caucuses in just a few months.

_**[But getting all of this done requires support.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8p42pto5i4i38skup1d11qi813n4dhipue8a408_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj6ao32cdh2bs "But getting all of this done requires support.")**_

body:
Every year, the National Taxpayers Union rates US Representatives and Senators on their actual votes

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt29en5h99fs2qq662mjn0gprfif2lm8rmoocpto_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctj6ap76c1h2bs)

Friend,

Every year, the National Taxpayers Union rates US Representatives and Senators on their actual votes -- every vote that affects taxes, spending, and debt.

And this year's results are awful. **48 Senators and 219 members of the House scored an F!**

It's no wonder we have a spending problem and a skyrocketing national debt.

Many in Congress are failing you, the taxpayer.

I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at the National Taxpayers Union (NTU). We are the "Voice of America's Taxpayers." Our mission is to achieve favorable, pro-taxpayer policy outcomes using the most effective team on Capitol Hill and in the states.

## DeSantis, Newsom to Debate on Hannity Show
Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis and California Gov. Gavin Newsom have [agreed to debate](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQxvGngY3ofIexGRi6eEvXjhaYc6DCJrJR0r59lcwdP_2kb_h_XeerzyXvt0-_sWtrnf3S8oNnsAqNQppRRrcyI5Nk1xnbDwS6NzK5xYRgO7PAOgQNwXjynWEi01lkjCSzQ0ACiwZsr4kuceTR9GPog0WwIwgNHHOrx-W75r0lXstvffBxWeomi0ut3U9BHwIngVNLnHIpLxM4pbrxzs9T4KQRu8GSes26qcin31s-lb8dzGqtP29RkYNvrPb6UAQCJ3m4eH_mUvJpBqHhtvn8fpft_xB_AQAA___5uV44) each other one-on-one on Nov. 30 on Sean Hannity's primetime Fox News show. The two governors have been [taunting and sparring](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn-N2YycMxg8eMjClq4Z0WEf4SpjR9gN6r-vUqlbp0_63vL07rf5hhw5PT5wJ1fXPKOv_KJZWQlGgp6hCW4lAtINuYux_aBV15tmczgYP5BHbUaPYVnBE1080qitHzqrG3agQCsLRtm-07oNI42mH5d-saDsqESnKHDNR_uZOdWN1vidX3S0Pu9NdFutzyL0VcAkYDrPs91LejMBEyX5VQRMic73PHPkyv7vybvEFGSggqlykTXLQAtWkpxkyi_aFzoETHjI6_Wy0f1OzeHC8-QYuZhBdOqxI8dfkfp_l58AAAD__wUYZWo) with each other for months over the policies in each other's states. Hannity first raised the idea of a debate in June, and both men soon signed on. Newsom has insisted on no live audience, and there's no word on that yet. "We want a debate, not a circus," said a Newsom spokesperson.
## Menendez Refuses to Resign from Senate
Sen. Bob Menendez, accused of bribery and caught with $550,000 in cash and gold bars in his home, insisted Monday that [he was innocent](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyhCAYhJ8GO5w_IBwUFGnsLm1KB-FHyaDcAHeOefqMV6fZYrf59vu-T3cbU9yXL7uhaSFP1rX4wgk0ZZIyPrHOm4DIkHdoPqQWNw6DkN1qIGjv5qAVn90gwDsEr1yQICQqLUMXDQPGQTMJWgyc916hkkLNYtYMtAIyAPrYcul_ctzbiiGd-YWld3nrkllbe1TCPwkbCRuP4-gLPhuWeu1Xk0vyhI3P-g5acbctF7rhjrvHX_rKR6W12ZO6vC8Fa6UhLmujc4kzlpO61ZYFK7046XVZEDZ2xfjHEVOKVd7IAMtmY3ojtf8N_QUAAP__EMVohQ) and wouldn't resign from office. Menendez said the cash found by investigators came from his [personal savings account](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uxCAQBp8Gd1h4-TEUFGncXdqUFjZr30YYToaclTx9dKnTfcUnzWg-bvMtUKK8v4cDfdvKHNZGT5yF42A4yBm66DdEQNmhH4zToxRKm-7u1bAN6-JAjdYMJpo1jDZIFc0irLLj0JEHAVI4MMJpJWUfLVqj7aIXB8JZwZTASK2c_Weh3O64pe_yxLNfy9Elf2_tUZl8YzAxmK7r6h8lUaO1vA4MpoxXZTC9KAwm4V5bM5gibhRy4wdmzBF_eCxfS8LKY7kyD3ugXBs_sdKeQ6OS-RpSqlyIYRid1t3p4-OilKiakSmxH4HSn1T7v9FvAAAA__-k92ZJ), which he had been withdrawing for 30 years in "case of emergencies." He didn't address the gold bars also found in his home. He hired lawyer Abbe Lowell, who is [also Hunter Biden's attorney](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1SxCAUQOGnIR0ZvCRsKChs0q2tZYafy-Y6BHYAN65P72htfZoz3_t1u1pKlG9v9kDTY9ms7_TATWgOioPcYAgmIgLKAc2L0vNFimlWw26cn5yQEYLESSqPzqNSWkYR4WJhhoEMCJBCgxJ6nqQcw4KLmhc3Ow1CL4JNAgP1UsePQrnvGNOzPLCOvhxDMnvv98bkK4OVwXqe5xjLV8az_XYG670k6uQbg9UVxw_MmAN-c8yJWm98_8wdK3cUMDceMGJuyG3vpWZ8clfJYX1ybxsO1YT7SSlRUxc2idthKf1t9P9VfgIAAP__gGBmnQ), to defend him on the charges. Lowell successfully defended Menendez in 2015 when he was accused of accepting illegal gifts.
## Four-Day School Week On the Rise
Many U.S. public schools are adopting a [four-day school week](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL_G7ohgsYEtKK5Jl2uvtBZYx9wRYxkuUf7-Ka9-5Wia0fy5LTfKJe_33_Rg39e6UOz5yYtEAUaAXmBMfmUG1iN7ZXC2Wk6zGTdvmJw2SNElMlEqRAhTCjbJVZEDNWYPErREMBLnSetLcuzM7MIcECQ6OUySU-71vPytee8br-Vdn3xeYn2MxW-9H23Qvwa4DnClY-dX-6gPnD3HwgNc1_r_FIne4sX8T7S41VqaiIVa4yYOOnnvTdBqjTMxWEcaSWkTMaBNNs0YVbBqPH06XrmU3IwdJnl_UC7fGf3nK18BAAD__zzEYno) to save money and help them recruit teachers, while parents worry about what to do with their kids on the off day. Currently, about 900 school districts use a four-day week, up from 650 in 2020, out of a total of 13,000 school districts. It's more likely in rural districts, but [one of the biggest](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAURp8Gb1j48mMYGLp4S9eOFoFLTEtMBCgob1-lc7dP-o50pPN12S8u5XTePt0dbY9ld76nJ-7MUFAU-A5TsBERkE9oF2XkypmQajrsonmIihvtvGNRG6lXgTou6-oNX4yfkgUGnBlQzEjB-Rw0aiX1VV4NMKMZEQxD6qXO3yWd_cCYX-WJdfblPmV79P5ohH8Q2AhsY4zZX9uJo71_Att7EtiaP0rJNKTWa_K9UUGDe9GB-EM7On9gbfThKp79jU_VhsdIOaemViLY7e5S_jP2_wP8BgAA__9huFzl) is Independence, Mo., where 14,000 students now take Mondays off. While it leaves parents scrambling for daycare and an alternative to school lunch on the off day, school administrators say it's definitely a draw for teachers. In Independence, teacher applications are up four-fold.

He hired lawyer Abbe Lowell, who is , to defend him on the charges. Lowell successfully defended Menendez in 2015 when he was accused of accepting illegal gifts. Four-Day School Week On the Rise Many U.S. public schools are adopting a to save money and help them recruit teachers, while parents worry about what to do with their kids on the off day. Currently, about 900 school districts use a four-day week, up from 650 in 2020, out of a total of 13,000 school districts. It's more likely in rural districts, but is Independence, Mo., where 14,000 students now take Mondays off. While it leaves parents scrambling for daycare and an alternative to school lunch on the off day, school administrators say it's definitely a draw for teachers. subject: My hero son is facing life in prison
body:
I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

I'm praying God will touch your heart as you read this letter to help me save my son, Michael.

Michael is a police officer who dedicated his life to keeping our community safe in Farmers Branch, Texas.

_**But now he might be facing a life sentence in prison for shooting a dangerous career criminal who tried to run Michael down in a stolen truck.**_

[**Will you help my son?**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9f353ykn4l3qfLM6IeMJROu-5G2SqU6jMcnjpJMmwL2AzZ_dh75CF6UWPJcpJ7ttklu92CaI_ROL7eTqN-DGCDbNsnhxu3YL04fQiIAEN5L6twBneJMk1IZTkgEbctETSmw0NlcrZY50_21MiZDRLS87zj6T3Qz7oSqQOhMi_GaC)

That's Michael in the photo.

[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9Qy49BfoomuX3KnFFrsn4SHRZP-z6-u44GEA3Y0QnCgW_nhW6SxGY_Cb_wVqmMKlxa1HMi6Qgs4TrWCwbAEhLTVOwxDBa_WxbvTyAbuVqLDJSWCSHAZG7zej9-QEMV3bk9DfPcpaDw4e2yGW3F82eJMDAnqarasnWy97NygHbNPr) [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9YHHr3W4AKe1czMjMc3zRysVkDgs1iIPiSIfXH5Z8RXde_E0dVuiFycRrHTfOljF3SmzJUC-UHOIAnObolNtNAUj3gePMUjXUEpTKPAzIzEWlYVNBhBqD9UTJl_sl6HHNGdSNDZBvdomYUDAUi6Fe0WL9bk4RtzhMBXsfxG1046h)

In addition to being a police officer, Michael is also a Master Gunnery Sergeant in the United Stated Marine Corps Reserve.

I knew when he joined the police department that it was a dangerous job.

Every night on the news I saw another story of a police officer ambushed or killed in the line of duty.

It's been a heart wrenching time for the families of police officers in recent years.

What I didn't expect was that so many Americans would turn their backs on Michael in his time of need.

I now realize that it's all about fear. Fear of being attacked as a racist.

Fear of going against woke politicians and bureaucrats.

Fear of losing their jobs.

I assumed that the police department, the prosecutor's office, and everyone else in the government and the community would have Michael's back.

**But I was wrong.**

_So_ _now_ _Michael 's_ _life_ _is_ _at_ _stake_ _for_ _simply_ _doing_ _his_ _job_ _and_ _we_ _have_ _nobody_ _to_ _turn_ _to_ _except_ _for_ _good_ _hearted_ _strangers_ _like_ _you._

**[Will you please help me save my son Michael?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9RBj7fKWnC_dXae1EIPD64uB91ZWbq2DnlgsO8Nw2Dg2ZjXIeyzTIzadHa6hU6JANcy5razGYHns0m3dMY3iQNEJlRDpmsqZgxodYu-A80RALHEekx3UtagN-iDzwZe3oPSVQz9FEYui5LxUuLGYZLUeCrqC07xe2niY9h_ePN4e)**

Let me give you some more of the details...

Michael and other Farmers Branch Police detectives tracked a stolen pickup truck to the parking lot of an "adult arcade."

The truck was stolen by a convicted felon who was well-known to the police.

Michael was assigned the task of arresting this man.

When the suspect came back to the truck, Michael pulled up and stepped out of his police car.

The criminal sped the stolen truck toward him.

Michael had to do what every police officer hopes they never have to do: he drew his weapon and fired.

The man driving the stolen truck died at the scene.

My son suffered back and leg injuries.

Michael had a split-second to think about if the career criminal speeding toward him was going to crush him to death with that stolen truck.

In that split-second, he did what he needed to do in order to save his own life and the lives of his fellow officers and community.

There's no doubt in my mind, and many others, that Michael made the right choice that day.

He should be considered a hero for putting his life on the line to protect others.

But right and wrong seem to have been turned upside down in the last few years.

Why else would they be trying to put my son in prison for murder for what he did?

That's why I'm willing to do whatever it takes to clear his name. **[Even if that means asking folks like you for financial support to help my son afford the best possible attorneys and legal advice.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9aRdmlvYhY9LIA0QpjwJPA1dKbqLZnnP5osCaPkLPlkej_wpGvLgog0zehAeNW5Azm2lfbVNj2idFlQ4fpBwRDa8NeSFa_42tF3QrH2hMjcRRzrvPtZ_ty8FohLT65QLSK8q4rM3dRJ5Qx3E-B9P1U6QaoyXi8AHFIXqTYdhRG1I)**

After the incident, Michael was distraught to hear the criminal died.

But the other officers assured him the shooting was justified.

And then our whole world was rocked.

**Just 8 days after the incident Michael was indicted.**

Experts described the indictment as "unusually swift." The president of the Dallas Police Association said:

"We have never had an investigation completed in less than eight days ready to hand over to the District Attorney. Never."

I knew in my heart something was wrong - and we would be facing the fight of our lives to defend Michael in court.

We started a fundraising campaign on the internet site "GoFundMe" to raise money for a proper legal defense.

After a few days, "GoFundMe" shut down the fundraiser.

They claimed Michael's actions as a police officer were an "act of hate" - and helping him violated their terms of service.

So in this anti-police climate, politically woke climate, the case was closed in their minds.

No "innocent until proven guilty." No due process.

Instead, my son was smeared as a "murderer" who committed a "hate crime."

Since then, my husband and I spent half our life savings on legal fees and bills to help Michael.

_With the investigation devastating my family... seeing Michael, an American hero, being smeared on the internet... and our family quickly running out of money to pay mounting court fees... hope was fading._

Until we heard about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). **LELDF is the best friend a police officer could ever have.**

LELDF defends good officers, like my son, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.

The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.

And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son!

**[Will you please consider sending a tax-deductible contribution to the LELDF so they can help my son beat his charges?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9Zyheemsh3Y8yOOJF6XxmlebJ7NQmOj11bqtApIYOeeCfP9w6LSPdLeweKU4L-k006cHdP0SnKW81lx0jx-5ty6PQNk9Hzl8tX6pNTXHWddTwaeFyrXa5lNoDGDVy5a3z_HpX0QRiyRiyAIgcTL46KUGQN4EztDA4proIj1SHuaR)**

You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers.

Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a **[gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more,](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9dCxREH3TLCh1Prm9wD3P57X6LbhR9CR8rhBfH92K4fHQgtyH32MioTisib0HJGoR0-evOSkWjZp_jGI70pEKWCoPPsBt8WxoAFgCjJtMRp48Cu_Cqoqa5PhQIx-tvB-CeOsxgPUCegggh6G3RhAebPP5xi6VuIlYUsxGXpNsz3I)** I pray you will consider doing so.

Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing.

If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers.

My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal.
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9VPhfSFXu_M9Cwm3b-t1nnhcaOckhuLpfwErzCbqNTUwwnVQDRxrlHjm98ot_PtL2vq8zlFAu50E_n-J4qZ7WeeBT6RUfKG49klf3cgj-keNisD8tBOVcHKB1tibrLZQ2vsQ66s9qP3Cmhr6nfMSVk0GpmPx0Fv5YO5g_RLt0LlH)
_That's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn_
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9dWtrjY15UJNAIHZGluNgh8DkBLU8-KKVOOCjnYNu1QBJCGzF3vk1AUQ4gwH4-z598kXDEDLD6TTiIB0oxs9enkFuQjBWB8wjfyKQ9igZzqgEPGmiwULpZ8GHrZ5im-iPT4mFKJkPUK4f0iNx0rfuJwPrV7TjTpHdgYp4BgLPq1c)
_That's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William_

I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today.

Sincerely,

Margaret Mary Dunn

And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind **[donation today of $35, $50, or $100](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c3ebc113ecae4d84a62246e388c1071b&_e=hUYiH8Knp-FpDWSH6qvHCn5_H_U0iWPyuTllQwV7ackuecP3WOttQvrO6dcCumOgVVzbasgFgawkkzT9H7Kv7sQb6mqbH6x4DhBCN9JGpkw1r4EED6Pf6AEvpkBcBFm4ueMlMQS6e2zaA3DPR36M0QAYhnujDAbqavLXhUFCGoxr2PTAcFQ23JwzksS8-Kis0-pSF6LK4UU4W2qNNO-n9TTkeYaLwLnNlhK4f9nfG1tkqwvgzvITTo_SizPXFceEswKg6-hI7uvueUlatzjDDxCmn984PTA725cEr5uOl-qEylmfg0gfj0VOp2P9ho1sDOkc9wlO62Ma2zGDgo_V6xcBmpErAbB7lAPRbENCBJC8TXr6k1u9UxDcrShmfm5x)** to help Michael will mean so much to my family.

The group's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department. And praise the Lord, LELDF saw it fit to help my son! You see, LELDF is a non-profit organization. It doesn't receive any funds from the government to help our police officers. Or, if the Lord has blessed you with the means to help with a I pray you will consider doing so. Please know any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. If you can't help financially today, I understand. And please keep Michael and our family in your prayers. My son Michael is an American hero who served our nation and his community. He shouldn't be locked behind bars for defending his life from a career criminal. That's a picture of Michael with his daughter - my granddaughter - Mary-Kaitlyn That's a picture of Michael with his Son - my grandson - William I pray you never go through something like this. But if you do, may God touch the hearts of kind people to help you - just as I'm praying He'll touch your heart to help my son today. Sincerely, Margaret Mary Dunn PS: LELDF relies on caring people like you to send donations so they can fight tooth and nail to help wrongly-accused police officers like Michael. And because LELDF is a non-profit, all donations are tax-deductible. Your kind to help Michael will mean so much to my family. \---------------- More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter! subject: Can I ask for just two minutes?

body:
I don’t want to miss your response. Can you take just two minutes to take this survey?

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zeoh9tfcq938f406vctvrvjfpq1lm47od9g1pr2o_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctgm4oj2clh2bs)

Friend, At the next debate, I plan to once again take my case for the future of this country directly to you. Before that, I want to make sure I've heard from my team on what top issues have you most concerned. I believe in service over self. As a leader, it is my responsibility to listen first to what you need. As Governor, I have always put the needs, jobs, and benefits of the people I serve over my own, and as President, I promise you I'll do exactly the same. **[Today, I'm reaching out to ask if you'd mind taking a minute to respond to my official Listening Survey:](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z67q5dgpd9qt3doif1u0t7rqlhdoe5hq58opqbr8_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctgm4oj2clh2bs "Today, I’m reaching out to ask if you’d mind taking a minute to respond to my official Listening Survey:")**
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z003tksdbjjaskup7g2mt2iqhh7mm9psgp6ag790_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctgm4oj2clh2bs)
---
Can I count on your response?

In Freedom,
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqv0pqmvh0o3gcmhr6r3s08r3afud2ndq1etijvg_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctgm4oj2clh2bs)
---
Ron DeSantis

---

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuak48jf3akmnlvskjrc6p57n9dsrvkvl0r1jojo_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctgm4oj2clh2bs)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:

---|---|---

| | **LIMITED TIME TO APPROVE NEW NATIONAL MARINE SANCTUARY: Sign the petition now to permanently protect critical ocean ecosystems and support Tribal demands! >> [_Add your name!_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2011529?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ** Oil and gas drilling threats loom over a rare ocean ecosystem in Central California. The proposed Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary is a biodiversity hotspot – with adorable Southern Sea otters, giant gentle whales, and leatherback sea turtles. But _**this one-of-a-kind habitat remains unprotected from greedy fossil fuel companies.**_ The Chumash Tribe is leading the effort to designate the National Marine Sanctuary and permanently protect its waters, wildlife, and culturally significant sites from fossil fuel drilling and pollution. **The VERY LAST opportunity to submit comments in support of the sanctuary is closing soon!** [_**Tell the National Atmospheric and Oceanic Administration to APPROVE the Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary before your final opportunity closes!**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2011530?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) ***128 SIGNATURES MISSING FROM your area** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2011531?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
As the first ever Tribal-nominated marine sanctuary, Chumash Heritage would set a precedent for protecting culturally significant coasts and waters. The proposed borders contain **ancient, submerged villages** and **traditional ceremonial sites.** Some Chumash elders have been fighting their entire lives for these protections – and now _we’re so close_.
**There is nowhere else in the world like the Chumash Heritage site.** Its unique combination of diverse wildlife and culturally significant sites warrant protection from the destructive fossil fuel industry. But **you’re running out of time to support the National Marine Sanctuary designation!** [_**Please, Friend, will you help amplify the demands of the Chumash Tribe and protect this special marine ecosystem?**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2011532?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

As a leader, it is my responsibility to listen first to what you need. **Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z427c7n5jb797kqbm9j566dsidbtbp3uj6514i40_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctgmcp34cth2bs)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn’t stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: “When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism.”

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor’s leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration’s overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor’s vision, this year’s legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida’s history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state’s infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

[**Ohioans deserve -- and have loudly demanded -- fair legislative maps, not this embarrassing attempt at continued political control in an equally divided state.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/70367453/429127754/154372300?refcode=20230924_AOTL_F_OHBiz_RedLite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRkMmQ5NjQ3LTY0NWMtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DWsWRYHVVrTtFYcglfelOpccMJiKLV0EuFfe3j9lAPk=)

* * *

...we must act decisively. The time for complacency is past. Last week, the Republican-led Commission gave the public less than 48 hours to respond in public comment meetings. This is a deliberate attempt to stifle the voice of the people.

“Record profits are not being distributed equitably.”

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20230925all_uaw&n=1)
---
Peter - This morning, Dr. West stood in solidarity with striking autoworkers in Tappan, New York, in cooperation with the United Auto Workers (UAW). This demonstration of unity comes at a crucial time when the gap between executive compensation and workers’ wages has reached alarming proportions. Dr. West plans to continue showing solidarity with UAW members nationwide, with a scheduled trip to Detroit on Wednesday.
---
---
While Detroit's three major automakers have seen CEO pay increase by a staggering 40% over the past four years, the workers on the factory floors have received a meager 6% wage increase during the same period. This stark disparity is unjust and unsustainable. **Dr. West, known for his decades-long history of advocating for workers' rights across various sectors, starkly contrasts with the duopoly that has historically prioritized the interests of mass corporate donors and an oligarchy class, perpetuating a system that enriches the few at the expense of the many.** Dr. West's mission is clear: to rally support for genuine solidarity against corporate avarice that sacrifices the precious poor and working people in the face of greedy bosses and profit-driven owners. Symbolic gestures alone are insufficient; substantive pro-worker policies are essential to rectify this injustice. As Dr. West aptly says, "This is a worker-led strike that recognizes record profits are not being distributed equitably. And we can’t allow certain actors in the auto industry nor any lawmaker to use the transition to electric vehicles as a cudgel. Any transition must be just and equitable, and until that happens, this strike is justified and righteous." **We seek your support to bring about meaningful change and address these critical issues.** [Your donation will help us amplify our message](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20230925all_uaw&n=2) and advance the cause of workers' rights, social justice, and economic fairness.

subject: Important Deadline - Sept 30th
body:

Dear Friend,
September 30th is days away and it is a very important date for a couple of reasons.
First, It’s a crucial fundraising deadline for my campaign. It’s the last day of the quarter and it’s the day we file a public report that illustrates how our fundraising is going. I’ll be honest—I am short of my goal. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. I need your help.
Can you chip in $100, $50, $25, or even just $10 to help my campaign reach its fundraising goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Second, September 30th is also the last day that the United States government will be funded before it’s shut down by radical Republicans in Congress. Not surprisingly, Scott Perry’s Freedom Caucus is leading the government shutdown push.
They are holding Congress hostage with their demands and using routine government bills—bills that are being passed in the Senate on a bipartisan basis—as leverage to force Congress to back their radical agenda. In the last few days, they’ve even stopped bills that would fund our military. Enough is enough. As your next Congresswoman, I will make sure Congress meets its basic obligations and our government remains open and running. I’ll fight against budget cuts that hurt our families, our farmers, and our armed service members. This shouldn’t be about politics and agendas—keeping the government open is the job of our elected leaders in Washington!
I can’t fight for you in Congress without your help now. Can you donate to my campaign before September 30th and help me show a strong fundraising number for my next public report? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
During the 2022 election, our campaign outperformed past candidates and put this race on the radar of the Democratic Party in DC. We were able to show that this race is winnable by running a smart and efficient campaign. Since then, Scott Perry and the other radicals in Congress have shown that Republicans can’t and don’t even want to govern. This district is ready for a change. As a second-time candidate, I know what works and what doesn’t. I know that without resources, I won’t be able to reach the voters we need to reach to win next November. I know we can’t run a typical campaign—we need to be smart and strategic. I did it once and I’m ready to do it again. With enough resources this time around, I know we can finish what we started last year.
Thank you for all you have done and will continue to do to have my back.
With gratitude,
Shamaine

Another huge thanks to the Belmont Recreational Center for coming through with their venue. And a special thanks needs to go to John Reid for having the courage to stand up to Antifa and their allies who do everything they can to cancel conservatives.

Before the event could take place, it had to be moved because the other venues backed out, caving to pressure from the radical left.

I'm personally boycotting both the Commonwealth Club and The Westin (Marriott Corp) for caving to Antifa and canceling this educational event, and I encourage you to do the same. I'm so sick and tired of conservatives getting cancelled.

We must unite together against domestic terrorists and their attempt to cancel conservatives. Have some courage people!

Andy Ngo certainly has the courage to do so. He is an independent journalist and photographer. He lives under threat for his reporting and expertise on Antifa.

He has testified before the U.S. Congress and appeared on countless television shows, radio programs, and podcasts.

His journalism has appeared in The Wall Street Journal, New York Post, Newsweek, National Review, Fox News, and more. Andy is currently the editor-at-large at The Post Millennial.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

September 26, 2023
Dear Friend,
We wish we were joking when we tell you that one vote can decide the Memphis Mayoral election.
There are no runoffs in the Mayor's race, meaning that whoever has the most votes wins, even if it's only one vote . This is why your vote matters. In fact, TVP Founder Mayor Lee Harris won his City Council race by four votes.
Right now, voter turnout is only at 5%. Will you forward this email to a friend and encourage them to vote?

🗳️ You can vote early at any of these locations: bit.ly/voteearly901 [bit.ly/voteearly901]
📅 Early voting is happening NOW until this Friday, September 30. Election Day is October 5.
✔️ TVP has endorsed a slate of candidates whose priorities are public safety, transit, and strengthening infrastructure. You can find our endorsements on our website [https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com/901endorsements] and see them below.
