| **_THE WASHINGTON POST:_
“Biden to Create New Office of Gun Violence Prevention”**
---
Peter, this is a massive win for our youth-led movement to end gun violence across the country.

Alongside young activists, organizers, and leaders like Stop Gun Violence PAC, I’m proud to have fought for the creation of a federal office of gun violence prevention.

**Ending gun violence has been at the forefront of my campaign. It’s what called me to action – both as the National Organizing Director for March for Our Lives and as the first of my generation to be elected to Congress.**

My generation has been demanding action. And today, we have real, tangible progress in this fight. Not incremental progress, but a massive push forward.

**This is just the beginning. But I know the NRA and gun lobby are plotting revenge against our movement. Stop Gun Violence PAC, and I need to be prepared, so we’re setting out to raise $25,000 over the next 24 hours to keep me in the fight to end gun violence.[_Can you split a $25 donation to my campaign and Stop Gun Violence PAC to power our movement for progress? >>_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70373385/429148695/-1503575736?refcode=BLU-SGVP-20230926-2-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0NTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTZkYzQ5ZDYtNzA1Yy1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=V5mpbwoY3cgtaw8nE1AS2cbd_48zchMNqHsnVAIEhjg=)**

**Peter, they said a young organizer wouldn’t stand a chance against the gun lobby and the NRA-bought Republicans in Congress.**

And when I introduced my first bill in Congress to establish a federal office of gun violence prevention, Republicans thought they succeeded in blocking it.

But I never gave up, and neither did Stop Gun Violence PAC. Now, the Biden Administration is taking action. Our collective power made this happen. This is proof that our youth-powered movement is unstoppable. And we’re just getting started.

**So today, we celebrate this win in the fight to end gun violence. Tomorrow, we _keep_ fighting. We _keep_ organizing. We _keep_ making noise.** But it’s going to be an uphill battle against major forces that will stop at nothing to crush our progress. **Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjfq8s7qdn5vclfjc2gj05oc0a2j7ghuumlglaog_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctgm9ob4c1h2bs)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

If you'd like to unsubscribe | | Hey Peter, it’s been a while and we have some new folks on our team, so I wanted to reintroduce myself. I’m Wesley Bell, a problem solver and public servant who was raised in North St. Louis County, and I’m running for U.S. Senate to fire Josh Hawley. As the son of a police officer and county civil servant, I was taught early on about the responsibility to stand up for others and my community. For me, that lesson meant becoming a problem solver, leading me into a career as a part-time judge and professor to serve my community. That's why when tensions erupted in Ferguson, I sprung to action. Instead of fanning the flames of culture wars like Josh Hawley, I rushed to step in to calm things down and mediate between police and protesters, and I did it because it was natural to me. There I learned that so much more could be done — so I ran for Ferguson City Council and won. Since then, I’ve continued identifying issues in my community while working closely to solve them as a public servant because public service is and will always be in my DNA. So when I saw the lack of leadership in the St. Louis County prosecutor's office in 2018, I knew something had to be done, so I took on the challenge of running against the Democratic political establishment — shocking everyone when I defeated the seven-term incumbent. As a problem solver and a son of North St. Louis County, I've worked to find solutions to big and small problems all my life. | | Hi Peter,

In 2022, the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) set up a program to demand that employers make reasonable accommodation for pregnancy.

It's called the _Pregnant Workers Fairness Act._

Sounds great, right?

It was... until the Biden Administration recently decided they want pervert the intention of this program in order to **force employers to accommodate abortions for their employees**.

Make no mistake - this is a MASSIVE new, government mandate for abortion.

Fortunately, when a federal regulatory bureau introduces changes, Americans have a period of time (60 days) to weigh in and give their views.

YOU can make your voice heard.

******[Can you submit a public comment opposing this change using this form?](http://newsletter.studentsforlife.org/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cCUzQSUyRiUyRnd3dy5zdHVkZW50c2ZvcmxpZmVhY3Rpb24ub3JnJTJGQ29tbWVudCUyRiUyM2Zvcm1lZW9j&sig=1EFL1NmdeNenJMuLbeViCN3WtAP9QHJ7kv9Mrp8iR1c&iat=1695755611&a=%7C%7C649951085%7C%7C&account=studentsforlife%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=CZb7G806lsYoacbbs2vn%2BXUsF9JYPFu9YiF7gN4V01sHpUda%3AtM99dVfkt2XUV3ObWAj7xEyuEaaZJwEt&s=e8ce76248dd02de8a72576da08bdf2f9&i=2860A2833A1A27262 "Original URL: https://www.studentsforlifeaction.org/Comment/#formeeoc. Click or tap if you trust this link.")**

_If you'd like to read the fine print, here is the EEOC’s_** _[summar y](http://newsletter.studentsforlife.org/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cCUzQSUyRiUyRnd3dy5lZW9jLmdvdiUyRnN1bW1hcnkta2V5LXByb3Zpc2lvbnMtZWVvY3MtcHJvcG9zZWQtcnVsZS1pbXBsZW1lbnQtcHJlZ25hbnQtd29ya2Vycy1mYWlybmVzcy1hY3QtcHdmYQ==&sig=CRUYuBPNgRgJExvYGtmTQf41CAzJ78cujwEGMA6BsdxL&iat=1695755611&a=%7C%7C649951085%7C%7C&account=studentsforlife%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=CZb7G806lsYoacbbs2vn%2BXUsF9JYPFu9YiF7gN4V01sHpUda%3AtM99dVfkt2XUV3ObWAj7xEyuEaaZJwEt&s=e8ce76248dd02de8a72576da08bdf2f9&i=2860A2833A1A27263 "Original URL: https://www.eeoc.gov/summary-key-provisions-eeocs-proposed-rule-implement-pregnant-workers-fairness-act-pwfa. Click or tap if you trust this link.")_** _of key provisions.___

We can't let President Biden and his Administration poison programs that are supposed to protect diversity in the workplace, including pregnant and parenting women, with their anti-baby bias.

And Peter, after you **[submit your comment](http://newsletter.studentsforlife.org/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cCUzQSUyRiUyRnd3dy5zdHVkZW50c2ZvcmxpZmVhY3Rpb24ub3JnJTJGQ29tbWVudCUyRiUyM2Zvcm1lZW9j&sig=1EFL1NmdeNenJMuLbeViCN3WtAP9QHJ7kv9Mrp8iR1c&iat=1695755611&a=%7C%7C649951085%7C%7C&account=studentsforlife%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=CZb7G806lsYoacbbs2vn%2BXUsF9JYPFu9YiF7gN4V01sHpUda%3AtM99dVfkt2XUV3ObWAj7xEyuEaaZJwEt&s=e8ce76248dd02de8a72576da08bdf2f9&i=2860A2833A1A27262)** , can you forward along this email to a pro-life friend or two so they can do the same?

Without our opposition, these heinous actions fly right under the radar.

Thank you for taking action (and asking some friends to, as well).

For Life,

The GOP chooses chaos instead of compromise every chance they get.
#
I need to tell you something, Peter.
Fundraising for Democrats is down across the board. Unfortunately, the GOP’s attacks haven’t slowed down to match.
Democrats were only able to protect and expand our Senate majority last year because grassroots supporters like you stayed strong. When the future of democracy, health care, reproductive rights, and so much more is at stake, there are no off years.
That’s why my team and I have set an end-of-quarter fundraising goal of $20,000. **[Will you help us reach this crucial goal? This is the second-to-last FEC filing deadline of the year, and we must do everything we can to reach it.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70380683/429175767/410513519?refcode=dd_em_230926_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMzUwNTAzNy03OTVjLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Mclt96GHiETHGU1ZhkjtXa9hc2GT6plnNLpu0d2EqsU=)**

My Democratic colleagues and I are doing everything we can to stop these games and build a country that puts working people first. Protecting and expanding the Democratic Senate majority is essential to putting an end to Republican nonsense and moving our country forward.
**********[Peter, I hope I can count on you. ---
| | |
---
| | | Dear Peter,

Biological males don't belong in girl sports - or locker rooms or bathrooms!

It is a safety and privacy issue for me. As the Virginia case documents, the safety of every girl is at stake when biological boys are allowed to freely enter their designated areas. In Virginia, a boy who identified as a girl entered the girls' bathroom and raped an unsuspecting victim. The incident was brushed under the carpet, and he was quietly transferred to another school - where he did the same thing again! He raped another girl!

Sean Casten has voted to allow boys in spaces designated for girls and is working against women - and our rights! Having full male genitalia displayed in the locker room is an affront to every girl there. Girls are not able to disrobe and shower in comfort. This puts every girl's mental and physical safety at risk.

Help me bring common sense back to Washington DC. Please consider making a contribution to my campaign. No amount is too small.

[](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=9aae552261&e=25f4fa3311)

Your support is greatly appreciated.
Stay strong!
---
| Thank you,

Niki Conforti

body:
We’re right around the corner from our important Federal Election Commission deadline
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=705%2E135344%2E4_e_0V)

Friends,
We’re right around the corner from our important Federal Election Commission (FEC) deadline: On September 30th, we will close the books on the third fundraising quarter of the year, and our first since a serious GOP contender entered the race. After this deadline, all of our contributions will be compiled into a public report that will be used to gauge the strength of our campaign.
**If you already know how important these deadlines are, please use this link to make a contribution to our campaign today:**
[**https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/Sept-Deadline](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep23.hbnlDo&refcode=em230926-1-15&t=2&akid=705%2E135344%2E4_e_0V)**
Given that your inbox is likely full of emails from campaigns like mine ringing the alarm bells, I thought I’d throw in a bit of history to this much ballyhooed event of the FEC deadline.
Each year, candidates running for federal office face four official quarterly fundraising deadlines – March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31. After these deadlines pass, we are legally required to report how much money we’ve raised and the number of donations we receive. You have to file your report within 15 days after the deadline.
These deadlines were put into law in 1974 by the FEC Act. This was driven by reports of serious financial abuses in the 1972 presidential campaign. The FEC Act created limits for how much individuals could contribute to a campaign and established the Federal Election Commission, which began operating in 1975. Since then, candidates running for federal office have to report what they raised, how much they spent, and how many individual donations they received four times a year.
**Unlike many in politics, I won’t give you a made-up emergency or try to convince you that the sky is falling with these deadlines.** But these quarterly reports do set the tone for what this campaign can accomplish in the coming months. Friends and competitors alike watch these numbers and make critical decisions for the road ahead.
So this is why I ask, and where it comes from. [**If you’d like to help us knock this FEC deadline out of the park, please consider chipping in $3 below. The sky will NOT fall if you don’t contribute, the country will NOT descend into chaos – but you WILL help us compete in one of the country’s most competitive Senate races! And isn’t that worth it?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep23.hbnlDo&refcode=em230926-1-15&t=3&akid=705%2E135344%2E4_e_0V)**

subject: Inslee’s costly UN trip
body:
Inslee used the opportunity to travel on the taxpayers' dime to job hunt at the UN. A flight from New York to Seattle emits 1,350 lbs of CO2. Considering the roundtrip, Gov. Inslee and his wife emitted about 5,400 lbs of CO2 to visit the Big Apple. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62294762:Wli3Tji8N:m:1:2610672541:2CAF8F2BE009E1A21175A055EDF1FA8C:r "Shift Washington")
---
|
Friends, Last week, Governor Jay Inslee was invited to speak at the United Nations as a so-called "do-er" on climate change. The concept that our green governor has actually achieved anything of substance on environmental policies is laughable. But that reality didn't stop Inslee and his wife from flying across the country so he could speak for a couple of minutes - all courtesy of the taxpayers. **In the last decade, the real Washington Story that Governor Inslee should have shared at the UN is that he has managed to miss every environmental goal set for our state. He has presided over the failure of his own state agencies to meet minimum green standards, record and rising carbon emissions for the state, and for weeks this summer with the highest gas prices in the nation (they have since settled in at #2).** Even during the COVID-19 pandemic - when the amount of people commuting for work plummeted - Gov. Inslee failed to meet a single carbon emissions target. Inslee is a "green" failure. Yet, he paraded around as a green hero at the UN. Adding hypocrisy to his failures, Inslee - who supposedly cares so much about carbon emissions - sure emitted a lot of carbon to glam around with pals like Al Gore as an environmental warrior at the UN. According to Travel Navigator, a flight from New York to Seattle emits 1,350 lbs of CO2. Considering the roundtrip, Gov. Inslee and his wife emitted about 5,400 lbs of CO2 to visit the Big Apple. **All those carbon emissions for a four-minute speech that Inslee could have delivered via Zoom - that is, if what he really cared about here was the environment. ** ** ** Of course, Inslee doesn't put the environment first. That's where he places his political ambitions - and, with his time as governor mercifully coming to an end, he now cares most about landing his next political job. So, to further his ambitions, Inslee used the opportunity to travel on the taxpayers' dime to job hunt at the UN. Unfortunately, the mainstream media has so far refused to question why Inslee did not just Zoom into the conference - or even how much taxpayers are on the hook for his political ambitions. And they certainly have not bothered to hold Inslee accountable for the differences between the Washington story he made up for his UN speech and the failures that dominate his Washington story here. That's why our work here at Shift WA is so important.** We need to let the public know the truth behind Inslee's UN trip and his real track record on the environment. _[But we need your help.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62294763:Wli3Tji8N:m:1:2610672541:2CAF8F2BE009E1A21175A055EDF1FA8C:r)_** ** ** Unfortunately, we are over $1,500 behind on our monthly fundraising goal.** It's so important that Shift WA has a voice in our state - and it's even more important that we re-double our efforts to ensure voters know what's really going on behind the scenes in our state.** ** ** **_[Will you help us ensure we can continue our work by contributing $150, $100, or $50 today?](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62294763:Wli3Tji8N:m:1:2610672541:2CAF8F2BE009E1A21175A055EDF1FA8C:r)_** We need the support of people like you.** _[Please consider contributing today.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62294763:Wli3Tji8N:m:1:2610672541:2CAF8F2BE009E1A21175A055EDF1FA8C:r)_** Thank you, The SHIFT WA team | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62294764:Wli3Tji8N:m:1:2610672541:2CAF8F2BE009E1A21175A055EDF1FA8C:r)

body:

---

---
| | |
# Welcome to the September edition of **The Moran Minuteman**.
This monthly newsletter is our way of recognizing extraordinary efforts in Texas Congressional District 1 and providing an inside look into what happens behind the scenes in the life of a Congressman.
---
|
---
| This month, we are back in Washington, D.C., after spending August traveling across the First Congressional District. One of the pledges I made when I ran for Congress was to never forget my East Texas roots and, most importantly, our East Texas values. While we were back home, I took the opportunity to return to Mercado's Cafe and wait tables, just like I did three decades ago as a student paying my way through college. We made a fun little video about it - I hope you'll check it out!
---
| [ ](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=cb2f5d54f1&e=bbce4dd6ad)
---
|
---
|
## Congratulations to our September Minuteman - Deana Brown
When I think of East Texans, I think of the [Minutemen of the Revolutionary War](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=fbbc5685ad&e=bbce4dd6ad). Loyal to country and community, dependable, selfless, and ready at a moment’s notice, the Minutemen were American heroes who helped turn the tide of the Revolutionary War. **Today’s East Texans reflect those traits.** You are patriotic, dependable, and deeply committed to making our communities better.

Each month, I will recognize an East Texan who has gone above and beyond in serving our region - someone who epitomizes the identity of a Minuteman. In addition to recognition in the monthly newsletter, we will send the person a Moran Minuteman t-shirt.

This month’s Minuteman, Deana Brown, has worked tirelessly to advocate for the freedom of worship across the globe. Deana is the Founder and CEO of Freedom Seekers International, an organization that helps those who are persecuted for their faith to relocate to places of safety. Earlier this year, Deana went to Thailand to help more than 60 persecuted Christians who were arrested the week before Easter and faced deportation back to China. Deana led an effort that eventually included a coalition of churches, non-profit groups, and government officials who came together to bring the group to safety in East Texas. She is now working to help resettle over 100 Afghans.
---
|
---
| Thank you, Deana, for your dedication to East Texas and the values of faith, family, and freedom we hold dear. It is an honor to recognize you as the September 2023 Minuteman.

Do you know an East Texan who would be a great next recipient? Please submit their name **[here](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=67757e04f4&e=bbce4dd6ad).**

Our Moran Minuteman team will also be out and about serving at community events and in disaster relief efforts. Look for us, and we’ll toss you a t-shirt!
---
| [Nominate a Minuteman!](https://nathanielmoran.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0775eb7c3a967d340caf4e913&id=db2ac4b62b&e=bbce4dd6ad "Nominate a Minuteman!")
---
|
---

## Talking with East Texans

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: An important deadline for Colin’s campaign
body:
And ours! |
---

| | | | As you know, my good friend Rep. Colin Allred is running to replace Ted Cruz in the U.S. Senate, and the choice between the two of them could not be more clear. **Colin is liked and respected on both sides of the aisle.** He shows up for his constituents. He connects with his colleagues. He works hard to find common ground and get things done. **Colin is proud of Texas and Texans.** Last week, we celebrated together the confirmation of San Antonio native and respected Air Force Chief of Staff General Charles “CQ” Brown as chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. Senator Cruz voted against him. **Colin is committed to our democracy.** He is leading efforts to restore the Voting Rights Act and ensure equal access to the ballot box for all Americans. I know Colin will deliver better, stronger leadership for Texans in the Senate—the kind of leadership he’s delivered in the House, the kind of leadership we deserve. name: Nikki Haley
subject: Moment to talk?
body:
First, I want to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3vg7gf0bmc936ncdbvg65tk0f1l97uf1cltenr8_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs)
---

Friend,

First, I want to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign's momentum ahead of the second debate in less than ONE WEEK!](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2pus0lhf6hc4f3m65bfprdelbmkq4og0qoqo49g_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum ahead of the second debate in ONE WEEK!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zuk66m3bpubd3h84cgu6ilev7fmvh8179tiop8ug_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs)
---

I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard-working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1dst80ji0bl5u3jiphqbrds5q323spq90e9ch50_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs)
---

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z38rhq7t1tfeiojvupdtt5qk1ptiaar09iddfnpg_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs)
---

Most importantly, I am running for president because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

Now, at this very moment in time, **I 'm about to hit a huge campaign milestone - my second Presidential Debate. [It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign before I take the stage.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfmk3gd0pqhtic1o1kpetttvp5kn11ev148tvkn0_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to show the strength of my campaign before I take the stage.")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today and to help me boost my campaign momentum ahead of the debate next week?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr03ltbapeoq9st3i7she4f7c6nglemsb4cm9ufo_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today and to help me boost my campaign momentum ahead of the debate next week?")**
---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zl88cu96usjnk99l9ndnad2rrtikll7g2bc2tc58_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs)
---
Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help again- starting right now.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z6rmfrdjmobs2atav4bd4jo53pib5mq4dieif0m8_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs "I need your help again – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zlpe9tnfdu3lgvat3pkdasf4qvvkhve8jvlv9loo_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs)
---
Nikki Haley

---

---
| | [GET YOUR HAT NOW](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2f1rhg17t1dabblmajng3hi1idi9m1sghigpmeg_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs "Claim Your Mug")
---
---
| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zlsjch469o1tpd2g4qnvst6sha2iuof7eha5m5oo_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z59a21pq0fqq157752sruvirk1svt9oul825t1vg_rp22sh2s8i66p75ctimapr2c1h2bs "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:
Parents have every right to make sure some extreme agenda isn’t pushed onto their children. |
---
[](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=98b266829f164eb2971b21990a5e03b7&_e=Rvgi3gB2O7YcDsYJLFJ0g_U_gZnx5NNPb4gSpNsFyHOF6STwEHz4fQrNXwxUXR-ZWlbw9Hp7pd1uJlryTxPpBuNx1RKivUjbcQzoT09Ao6KwvrxFo4UJf5ecEuncHbtW4RX6vRGgXM0vv_8ddt4dn7HeHU13Swmszxqfz0vUWcw0zxLqFC7ztnvNZP4492kE_WNvY-8ai9j7SZyImAag9MKNZF10DSyRoc8ymGqpRj5uobZdCyCsM57b1Su36bdj0BlAroAX69XDP4TeOEwkRBK5RO1Ub9xiyLSWJw88A2PtNbNAtbANVxjV9eUkLp10I4bxsUpZF8zddfQrNQsvoWkEbVY3jGEoFGyyxHuDx05_pAit5iE6g19mV_FCWrIykeokxVAIzq10-MOC4FAT9CiBA0jQVgAizhIrZ-Ip_I4%3D)

Fellow American,

Why does the Left want to vilify parents who are concerned about their children’s education? Parents know best when it comes to their child’s education. That’s why parents deserve the right and ability to choose what is best for their child -- in public schools, charter schools, private schools, religious schools, and homeschooling.

I stand with the parents who are challenging the bad policies keeping them in the dark. It’s more leftist social programming that does nothing but divide Americans. It’s wrong and it’s time to push back against the blatant overreach leading to future generations’ indoctrination.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI Improvements to our state's infrastructure Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. name: Dr. Shawn Wilson for Governor
subject: Two more debate wins (and another coming tonight!)
body:
image of ... [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/swlogo2.png]
TEAM WILSON WEEKLY UPDATES
Peter,
I was proud to join all of the candidates for Governor in another statewide television debate Friday, September 15th in Lafayette . I was proud to present Louisianans across the state with an option for Governor who has real plans to address their real concerns, and not just culture war sound bites about things that rarely impact Louisiana. If you missed it, you can watch the full debate here [https://www.klfy.com/your-local-election-hq/watch-live-louisiana-governor-debate/?fbclid=IwAR2RooZw5n6xL2y029vXhxFzd3AYwrBfAJjrdwPY_g5ocLJRsiBsI3V2Qdw] .
I was also honored to participate in the student-run virtual gubernatorial forum at Southern University on Tuesday. I was proud to share my message of optimism and I look forward to being the FIRST Louisiana Governor with a Master's degree and PhD from Southern . Watch the debate here [https://www.youtube.com/live/5BPFluDuavo?si=jUITT4YUECmFI0DA] . Geaux Jags and geaux vote! Early voting starts THIS SATURDAY, September 30th!
I am honored that my candidacy for Governor has been endorsed by Gambit Weekly . In their glowing write-up of my positions, goals, and experience, they highlighted my platform that puts people over politics, prioritizes collaborative, common sense leadership and fights for the future of our great state.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
I am also proud to announce that The New Orleans Tribune , the first Black daily newspaper in the United States, has endorsed my candidacy [https://theneworleanstribune.com/2023/09/20/can-louisiana-go-wilsons-way/] for Louisiana Governor. While I seek to be the first Black man elected Governor of our state, what drives my campaign is addressing the concerns that everyday Louisianans face every day.
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sw-web]
HIGHLIGHTS FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL
Lafayette
Last Friday’s GOTV luncheon with over 260 women in attendance was just the booster I needed before that night’s debate.
The luncheon was billed "The Women Are Coming!" so watch out! Early voting starts on September 30th and they're spreading the word about a Governor who will work everyday to make Louisiana Safer, Smarter, Healthier, & Wealthier.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
I was grateful to be welcomed with open arms before and after last Friday night's debate, including at Telly’s Place post-debate party, featuring some amazing fish & shrimp stew.
Although the debate was held on the eve of Rosh Hashanah , excluding our Jewish neighbors, and competed with Friday night high school football, I was pleased the Northside High coach stopped by!
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
New Orleans
On our way to the Teamsters meeting, Rocki and I had to stop to get a taste of New Orleans at Cafe Du Monde ! Having a couple of beignets definitely set the mood for our day.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
Raising wages in Louisiana is critical to our communities and a cornerstone of my campaign. Our people work hard and deserve an economy that works for them. So I was beyond glad to meet with the Teamsters .
Louisiana working families are not only concerned with building a livelihood for themselves, but also with being able to leave something for their children and the generation to come. We must invest in our workers and our businesses. Period.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
Terrebonne Parish
Team Wilson was welcomed to a full crowd at the Terrebonne DPEC Get Out The Vote rally !
I enjoyed connecting with Governor Kathleen Babineaux Blanco’s cousin and sharing in the rich history of “Lache pas la patate!” which goes back to Governor Edwin Edwards and means "don’t give up"! We sure won’t be giving up until we’ve reached every last voter possible. 💪🏾
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
Westwego
Team Wilson had a great time with family, friends, and supporters at the Pho Festival in Westwego. I was grateful to visit with Mayor Robert Billiot and other elected officials and enjoy some amazing Shrimp Rangoon. As Governor, I will always embrace the rich diversity of our state and respect its history and heritage.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
After a full day spent in Jefferson , Orleans , and East Baton Rouge parishes, Rocki & I engaged in a local political tradition in Lafayette and visited The Brass Room . Happy Birthday week, Gloria!
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
Civics for the People
Thank you to my friend Gary Chambers Jr. for hosting a Civics for the People in a Town Hall format. He and Anthony Kinney brought a passionate group of voters together to talk about what's at stake in Louisiana, and learn about my campaign and what’s in store for our state when I am elected Governor. It's about creating a home that's safer, smarter, healthier & wealthier. It all starts with Early Voting beginning on September 30th!
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
New Orleans
I spoke with IBEW in New Orleans and thanked them for their support and shared my commitment to creating good-paying jobs.
Then I toured the apprenticeship program that was in training. This is what building a workforce looks like, and it's one of my commitments as your next Governor.
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
East Feliciana Parish
I had a wonderful time at the "Souls to the polls" candidate forum at the East Feliciana Ministers Conference .
With Early voting starting September 30th, the time is now to get souls to the polls!
Let's geaux, Team Wilson!
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
Shreveport
I spoke with the Louisiana Realtors , presenting a substantive approach to addressing the state's insurance crisis that is crippling families as they seek affordable housing.
The economic opportunities before Louisiana are threatened if we don’t do something sustainable to fix the problem and protect families and their largest investment - their homes.
Learn more at wilsonforla.com/housing [http://wilsonforla.com/housing]
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
ENDORSEMENTS
Former US Senate candidate Luke Mixon
"Dr. Shawn Wilson's collaborative nature helped turn a budget deficit into a surplus, all while starting and completing countless construction projects that improved Louisiana's infrastructure," said former US Senate candidate Luke Mixon . "I am incredibly optimistic about what a Wilson administration will accomplish for Louisianans. I anticipate continued progress in access to high quality education, healthcare, and so much more. I am ready to elect Shawn Wilson as Governor."
wilsoforla.com [wilsoforla.com]
Greater New Orleans Legislators
As a native son of New Orleans, I am honored to announce an additional five legislators from the GNO area have thrown their support behind my campaign.
Thank you to State Senator Royce Duplessis and State Representatives Kyle Green , Rodney Lyons , Candace N. Newell , and Matthew Willard for your endorsements!
wilsoforla.com [wilsoforla.com]
State Representative Dustin Miller
"There's no better representation of state government working effectively than the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development under the direction of Dr. Shawn Wilson," said State Representative Dustin Miller . "From hurricane debris removal to an over $10 million investment on much-needed construction on LA13, LA 182, and US 190, Dr. Wilson's DOTD delivered for St. Landry. I am excited to see Louisiana flourish under Governor Wilson."
wilsoforla.com [wilsoforla.com]
UPCOMING EVENTS
Another debate is coming up and you can bet I'll be there! I'm excited to participate in the Gray Television, Inc. debate Tuesday, Sept. 26th at the University of New Orleans .
Watch the debate on all Gray TV affiliates across Louisiana including WVUE , WAFB , KSLA , KNOE , KPLC & KALB .
Mark your calendars and tune in!
wilsoforla.com [wilsoforla.com]
To learn more about my candidacy visit wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com] .
HOST SHAWN AT AN EVENT [events@wilsonforla.com?subject=Host%20Shawn%20At%20An%20Event]
JOIN WOMEN FOR WILSON [wilsonforla.com/women]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sw-web]
Hope to see you soon!
Shawn Wilson
https://www.facebook.com/ [https://www.facebook.com/] https://twitter.com/ [https://twitter.com/] https://instagram.com/ [https://instagram.com/] https://www.linkedin.com/ [https://www.linkedin.com/]

Wilson for Louisiana
P.O. Box 4572
Baton Rouge, LA 70821
United States

body:

It's official now, Peter.
Mitch McConnell and his GOP cronies got what they wanted: Dave McCormick -- a mega-millionaire hedge fund guy who can spend HUGE sums of his own money and self-fund this race -- jumped in the race to beat Bob Casey + flip PA's Senate seat red.
The biggest mistake grassroots Democrats can make right now is to sit by and think that Pennsylvania is a safe blue state. Personally, I sure can't forget that Donald Trump won the Commonwealth on Election Night in 2016.
**National Republicans are getting ready to spend potentially more than EVER before to flip Pennsylvania red in 2024.**
As someone who's spent nearly half a century electing Democrats and winning tough elections across the country, including in the Keystone State, let me assure you: _Pennsylvania is as competitive a battleground as it ever was._
**[I'm urgently asking folks today: Will you chip in $5 or more to Bob Casey? With millions set to pour in against Democrats, we CANNOT take Pennsylvania's Senate seat for granted!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230926-1?refcode=em20230926-1&refcode2=757_552475_mKIhkI&akid=757%2E552475%2EmKIhkI)**

name: COURIER
subject: No paywalls, no BS, just the truth
body:
Good journalism doesn’t lock its bylines behind a paywall.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1625%2E120351%2E2s5Asy)
Peter,
American journalism is in crisis. Led by bad actors like Tucker Carlson, Fox News, and Breitbart, right-wing media outlets keep harming our democracy by spreading dangerous conspiracy theories and lies.
Unfortunately, the mainstream media seems completely unable (or unwilling) to stop them.
COURIER was founded to take this crisis head-on.
We’re committed to fighting back by providing factual, hard-hitting reporting to the communities that need it most — _without_ hiding our bylines behind a paywall or subscription model.
You can read more about what makes our accessible reporting different from its paywalled counterparts in the email below, but if you’re short on time and still want to support good journalism, **[please pitch in $5 or anything you can today ahead of our end-of-quarter deadline.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230926?refcode=em20230926&amount=5&refcode2=1625_120351_2s5Asy&akid=1625%2E120351%2E2s5Asy)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230926?refcode=em20230926&amount=5&refcode2=1625_120351_2s5Asy&akid=1625%2E120351%2E2s5Asy)**
Thank you!
— The COURIER Team
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: **Courier Newsroom Team** [info@e.couriernewsroom.com]
Date: Fri, Sept 15, 2023 at 3:20 PM
Subject: No paywalls, no subscription fees. Just honest journalism.
Courier provides reliable news coverage in "news deserts" across the country, with no paywalls or subscription fees. Instead, we rely on contributions from supporters like you. **[With our mid-month fundraising deadline approaching, can you pitch in anything you can to help us reach our goal of raising $7,500 by midnight tonight? Thank you for your support.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230926?refcode=em20230926&amount=&refcode2=1625_120351_2s5Asy&akid=1625%2E120351%2E2s5Asy)
---
Peter,
**The mainstream media is failing.** By prioritizing profits and the illusion of “balance,” the public is losing trust in one of democracy’s most important institutions. To make matters worse, by chasing clicks and rushing to present “both sides of the story,” many media organizations consequently provide oxygen to right-wing bad actors and their efforts to spread misinformation.
It’s how Donald Trump became President. It’s how climate change denialism became mainstream. It’s how anti-vaccine propaganda spread to every corner of the Internet.
We could go on and on, but here’s the good news:
**Courier was founded as a bold response to these failures. We don’t chase profit and will never compromise our values in our reporting.**
**Our mission is to bring reliable, trustworthy news to the communities that need it most.** We call out misinformation in real time, by providing context and factual reporting in the spaces where misinformation thrives.
Currently, we’re operating in nine states, but we want to keep expanding! By providing credible, fact-based coverage in battleground states like Arizona, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Virginia, Florida, Iowa, North Carolina, and Nevada, we can keep voters in these key states informed as they head to the ballot box next year.
**And we do it _without_ paywalls or subscription fees in order to make our reporting as accessible as possible.**
But running a growing network of newsrooms doesn’t come cheap, and without the revenue stream provided by subscription fees, we rely on contributions from donors like you to sustain our operations. Today we’re approaching our mid-month fundraising deadline for the month of September, so we’re reaching out to ask for your help.
**[If you want to support Courier's mission of providing accessible, reliable, honest journalism that's committed to combating misinformation, please consider pitching in anything you can so we can meet our goal of raising $7,500 by midnight. We truly can't do it without you.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230926?refcode=em20230926&amount=&refcode2=1625_120351_2s5Asy&akid=1625%2E120351%2E2s5Asy)
**[Donate now ➡️](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230926?refcode=em20230926&amount=5&refcode2=1625_120351_2s5Asy&akid=1625%2E120351%2E2s5Asy)**
Thank you, Peter.

In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

* ESG prohibitions

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

| | Dear Peter, I am thrilled to share that Miguel Medrano was recently appointed as my campaign co-chair alongside former Senior Advisor to President Clinton, Justin Cooper. Miguel's impressive background includes serving as an elected member of the Penjamo Yaqui Pueblo Board of Directors, an organization deeply rooted in one of AZ-01's and Scottsdale's oldest and most distinctive communities. His extensive and diverse skill set has been honed through a variety of roles and experiences, notably as the former Executive Director of the Maricopa County Democratic Party, located in one of the largest counties in the United States. Miguel's commitment to the Democratic cause extends beyond administrative roles, as he actively participated in field operations during the 2008 Obama campaign and served as a State Director for the Obama campaign in 2012. His expertise in campaign management and advisory services has been sought after by state party leaders, elected officials, candidates at all levels, and grassroots activists across the nation. Furthermore, Miguel has proudly demonstrated his dedication to both civic and national service by serving our country as an Army Non-Commissioned Officer, completing multiple tours of duty in Iraq. Miguel's wealth of experience and unwavering commitment to our campaign's mission make him an invaluable addition to the team.
