Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| | Hello Peter. I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself to the entire grassroots team at the Democratic Party of Georgia.

My name is Tolulope Kevin Olasanoye, but you can call me Kevin.

I’m coming to Georgia from my time at a number of other state parties, and I’m excited to get to work here in Georgia. We have a huge opportunity to build something truly special in Georgia – an established Democratic presence that will continue to elect strong Democrats for decades to come.

We’re at an inflection point for the state. After 2020 and 2021, so-called “election experts” weren’t sure whether Georgia going blue for Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, Jon Ossoff, and Rev. Warnock was an anomaly. After 2022, people still aren’t sure. 2024 is our opportunity to solidify Georgia as a true battleground state for decades to come.

What happens next year is a huge opportunity. It’s an opportunity not just to continue Georgia’s path to becoming a Democratic stronghold – it’s an opportunity to elect politicians who care about families like mine and yours.

I want my daughter to grow up in a world where she has the rights and opportunities that should be afforded to her. I want her to have access to health care. I want her to go to school without fear of gun violence. I want her to have a future where climate change is no longer a constant worry.

**Together, we can build that future, and it starts here with us.** [**_I’m asking you to believe in Georgia. Will you help me to build not just a party that will keep Georgia moving toward Democrats but a future for all of us?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70391985/429214339/710125701?refcode=20230926.1_KO_9AI&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YzQ1MjI0ZS04YTVjLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yaSLcTxKJhwks8QW9h3Sv8WMlk8npwT2xkfagltnWvQ=)**_

When I think of Georgia, I think of untapped potential, of opportunity, of growth and the future.

clean_body: Introducing myself | | | Hello Peter. I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself to the entire grassroots team at the Democratic Party of Georgia. My name is Tolulope Kevin Olasanoye, but you can call me Kevin. I’m coming to Georgia from my time at a number of other state parties, and I’m excited to get to work here in Georgia. We have a huge opportunity to build something truly special in Georgia – an established Democratic presence that will continue to elect strong Democrats for decades to come. We’re at an inflection point for the state. After 2020 and 2021, so-called “election experts” weren’t sure whether Georgia going blue for Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, Jon Ossoff, and Rev. Warnock was an anomaly. After 2022, people still aren’t sure. 2024 is our opportunity to solidify Georgia as a true battleground state for decades to come. What happens next year is a huge opportunity. It’s an opportunity not just to continue Georgia’s path to becoming a Democratic stronghold – it’s an opportunity to elect politicians who care about families like mine and yours. I want my daughter to grow up in a world where she has the rights and opportunities that should be afforded to her. I want her to have access to health care. I want her to go to school without fear of gun violence. I want her to have a future where climate change is no longer a constant worry. Together, we can build that future, and it starts here with us. =**_ When I think of Georgia, I think of untapped potential, of opportunity, of growth and the future. Together, we can shape the future for ourselves and our future generations. | | Imagine federal law enforcement, TSA workers, air traffic controllers, and active-duty military service members working without pay. Imagine routine food and safety inspections diverted. Food stamps delayed and kids going hungry. Seniors and Americans with disabilities unable to get help with their Social Security benefits. **This is the reality our country will face if House Republicans get away with their stunt to shut down our federal government.** Once again, the most extreme Republican members of the House are holding our country hostage, refusing to agree to fund the federal government after funding runs out at the end of the month, just so they can jam their extremist agenda through Congress. They're treating the American people like theoretical numbers on a spreadsheet — but the truth is, the fallout of a government shutdown would have _very real_ consequences for millions of Americans. Republicans are – yet again – driving our country and our economy to unimaginable chaos just for political gain. This is the reality of Republicans in power. We cannot let them get away with it. **I'm outraged to see these extremists play such callous games with people's livelihoods and our economy.** Democrats are ready to negotiate a bipartisan funding deal in good faith. Only time will tell if Kevin McCarthy is capable of getting his members to do the same. I'm going to do everything in my power to keep shedding light on what a complete government shutdown will mean for families, and continue to advocate for a resolution to this Republican-induced crisis. subject: Some sad news to share
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gloria for Tennessee
body:
I miss my mom already.

| Hi there, No one loves you like your mother and I had one of the absolute best moms a person could ask for. Nell Johnson, my mom, died yesterday morning after a 90-year life filled with love, generosity and great cheer. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70392599/429216675/-1740789623?s=20&refcode=ea.d6c7db13-8c5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ms=ea.d6c7db13-8c5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmM3ZGIxMy04YzVjLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CIjICb3_jI6Pwca9HvUHhygwvYEPgKJxjFespmJ3mLk=&emci=c66a119b-815c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=d6c7db13-8c5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=46764483) I'll miss our long talks, our day trips, Sundays at her “petting zoo”, and family time. Both my parents taught me lessons and values that I hold dear still today. Growing up, I learned quickly that we treated people with respect and care — regardless of who they were, where they lived or how much money their family had. She was always my loving and supportive mom, but she would care for any child (or adult) who came through our door, played in our yard or befriended her children. That's who she was. That concern for others left a big imprint on me and even inspired part of my decision to become a special education teacher, working with kids regardless of who their parents were or what their family life looked like. Mom taught us to stand up for our beliefs, to work hard for our goals and to think for ourselves. She was always a "Mama bear." Though she was a lifelong Republican voter, Mom was fiercely defensive of me and let more than a few people know exactly what she thought of the gross attack ads deployed against her daughter during campaigns. Though we didn't always see eye to eye on party politics, she was a pillar of support for me and always had my back. And this summer, when I had the opportunity to travel to the White House, Mom was the first guest on my list. I'll never forget President Joe Biden sitting with us inside the Oval Office. He took my mom's hands and shared a story about his own mother. It was a beautiful moment that I'll treasure. A mother's love is a powerful gift to a child — and one that she kept giving her entire life. With all my heart, I miss you already, Mom. Thanks for taking the time to read, Gloria

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

subject: This will be my final term in office

body:
Serving the people of VA-10 has been the highest honor of my life.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70393608/429220397/-876189841?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZGNmNWEzMC04ZTVjLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Rzz2PZROuJrbpgzPcSboOwmtyojpBfm8XbbY7usjmD0=&emci=ba5a7da6-c35b-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=bdcf5a30-8e5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=32654120) By now, some of you will have seen [the news](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70393609/429220398/-217684819?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZGNmNWEzMC04ZTVjLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Rzz2PZROuJrbpgzPcSboOwmtyojpBfm8XbbY7usjmD0=&emci=ba5a7da6-c35b-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=bdcf5a30-8e5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=32654120) about my plans for 2024. I wanted to take a couple of minutes to reach out to all of you who have been a part of Team Wexton – to share my endless gratitude, explain my decision, and reflect upon my time in Congress.

Back in April, I shared that I had been diagnosed with Parkinson’s Disease. At the time, I made the decision to carry on with my Congressional work and political activity. My doctors believed that my condition would not stop me from performing my duties in Congress, and my goal was to stay in office for years to come.

During the months that followed, as my symptoms worsened, I sought additional medical opinions and was given an updated diagnosis of progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP). It is a rare neurological disorder that is often mistaken for Parkinson’s in its early stages– but while both are progressive degenerative diseases, PSP develops far more rapidly.

After some difficult and honest conversations with my family and doctors, I’ve concluded that juggling the realities of a re-election campaign in a tough district while managing the symptoms of my PSP is not feasible for me. **It’s with a heavy heart – yet also a deep appreciation for the privilege I’ve been granted by the people of Virginia’s 10th District – that I will be retiring from Congress at the end of my current term.**

I entered politics to make a positive difference in people’s lives. And in the nearly five years I’ve served in Congress, I’m proud to have been able to help pass historic legislation that lowered the cost of healthcare, created jobs, rescued industries, provided relief when the American people needed it most, and jumpstarted clean energy production, semiconductor manufacturing, and new infrastructure.

I plan to dedicate my final 15 months in Congress toward further progress. I hope to use my platform to raise awareness of PSP and other rare diseases. I’ll work tirelessly to protect human rights, the livelihoods of the federal workers in my district, women’s reproductive autonomy, and the tenets that uphold our democracy. And most immediately, I will continue to aid downballot candidates in the elections this fall that will decide the future of the Commonwealth.

Ever since I first announced my candidacy for Virginia’s 10th District in 2017, so many of you have welcomed me into your communities – even into your homes. Every conversation and interaction we have had made me appreciate public service more. Together, we have made a difference, and I know that the successes we have achieved will last for years to come and provide a blueprint for future leaders to build from.

I wish that I could serve longer. But being able to serve at all has been the highest honor of my life. And it was people like you that made it all the more worth it.

To my family, to my staff, and to all my supporters: thank you for everything.

Sincerely,

Jennifer

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

I’m a trans woman, 9th generation Texan, mother of two, and I’m running for Congress in Texas’ 32nd district. Republicans don’t want to see me win. We have a unique opportunity in Texas’ 32nd district to do what no one else in the country can do. We can elect a highly qualified trans woman to Congress for the first time in our nation’s history, and we can do it right here in Texas, the epicenter of the Republican hate machine. Together, we can send a clear message that hate, discrimination, and bigotry will not be tolerated in Texas. And if change like this is possible in Texas, then it’s possible anywhere. | Team, Do you know the lesser of two evils principle? That when someone is faced with selecting from two immoral options, the least immoral one should be chosen? Well, when it comes to our state’s Republican Senate candidates – unfortunately, there’s 3. And they’re all equally evil. **And they’re all bad for Ohio.** Bernie Moreno, Frank LaRose, and Matt Dolan all support restrictive abortion bans – including bans with no exception for rape or incest. In fact, they all celebrated the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_. The cornerstone of their campaigns is attacking reproductive rights. | **Michigan GOP Congressional Delegation Endorses Barrett**
---
(CHARLOTTE, MI) – Today, congressional candidate Tom Barrett, received the endorsement from Michigan’s entire Republican delegation to the U.S. House of Representatives. Barrett is running for the 7th District, an open seat in 2024, and slated to be the country’s most competitive race in 2024. This is a must-win seat for the Republicans to hold their House majority.
---

| | | | |
---|---|---|---|---

---
> _**“We are proud to endorse Tom Barrett for Michigan’s 7th District. His distinguished service to our country, his deep Michigan roots, and his leadership in the state legislature make him the most qualified and experienced candidate to be the next Congressman from the 7th District. Tom is by far our best chance to flip this seat next year, helping us grow our Republican majority and reverse Joe Biden’s disastrous policies.”**_
---

---|---|---|---|---
[_ _ I SUPPORT TOM!_ _](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6513154498a63a0fae934fad&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fstopteambiden-copy-679fbdd2778fe5ac&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_6512eab098e4452c5624d271&l=en-US&s=PLOtgWhjtfOSZDDcQ4Vq4Hgi-cw%3D)
---
“I’m honored by this endorsement, and the confidence in my candidacy. We will fight for every inch in this campaign and leave nothing to chance. As a 22-year U.S. Army veteran, family man, and native Michigander, I will fight for the priorities of the people who live and work in mid-Michigan. Working with the rest of my colleagues, we will rein in Bidenomics, secure our borders, support our police, and deliver results to the people of Michigan. I’m not running to get a job, I’m running to complete the job,” said Barrett.
---

body:
Alysa here, with an update from Team Andy.

It's been a whirlwind over here at Andy Kim HQ since Andy announced he's running for Senate! The outpouring of support has been incredible , with people from all walks of life getting involved.

Folks have been reaching out by phone, email, text, social media, and even stopping Andy on the street to tell us that they're excited to get behind an elected official who's "in it for the right reasons" (we've heard that phrase a lot ).

As Team Kim's resident data nerd, I want to tell you what this movement looks like on my end, by the numbers.

(But first, will you join in and help power our movement forward with a donation before our end-of-quarter deadline?) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stand-with-andy-kim-ak4nj?refcode=2023-09-26-backend&recurring=&amount=4&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=3d4dd8a1-935c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73]

Since Andy's announcement, we've had over 2,500 grassroots donations come in!

And the number that's really eye-opening? Of those initial contributions, 60% come from first-time donors.

In other words, people aren't just telling us that our campaign is getting them especially fired up; they're showing us – and they're pitching in to get the word out to every corner of this state.

The numbers don't lie: the people of New Jersey are ready for a change. Ready to elect Senators they can trust. Ready for Andy.

body:
It seems increasingly likely that the GOP is going to shut down the government.
#
It seems increasingly likely that the GOP is going to shut down the government.
They have time for a sham impeachment. They have time to vote on ideological purity tests to strip members of the Military of their right to reproductive health care or to restrict funding for Ukraine in their fight to defend democracy and prevent a wider war that could involve US Troops.
But they can’t get their act together to fund the government — to make sure the Military gets paid, on time, for their service to our nation.
It’s just unbelievable.
A few weeks ago, we reached out and asked if some of you would support us sending a few Veterans up to DC to meet with Senators and Members of Congress and demand action. The response was overwhelming.
**So here’s the deal: We’re in.**
We’re budgeting this out right now, and we’re going to fly in as many Veterans as possible. And here’s a part you can help out with personally:
A flight from swing-state Arizona costs anywhere from $170 to $300, depending on the day and the time. If you and 29 others chip in $10 each, that is one Veteran in DC. We’ll fly in Vets from all over, but that’s just one example.
So how about it, Derek: **[Chip in $10, and help fly a Veteran to DC. Or chip in more, maybe $25. Or chip in even more than that — whatever you think is the right amount. Let’s take DC by storm.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-c4-em-sept23.O64nR3&refcode=em230926-1-15&t=1&akid=17277%2E3013755%2E0KUuVp)

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

For over 50 years, the late Georgia Congressman John Lewis fought to uplift communities of color, risking his life in the segregated South so that people could exercise their constitutional right to vote. His vision led to one of the greatest achievements in our nation’s history, the Voting Rights Act of 1965.

Yet in recent years, vicious attacks on these fundamental rights have eroded American democracy, in the form of appalling voting restrictions emerging in Republican-led states.

Sign the petition: Demand that Congress protect the integrity of our elections by passing the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act! [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/john-lewis-voting-rights-advancement-act-petition?contactdata=h/qS1JX8Rly8eETo0exBaM2ncbonKpQhc0POTPpyUONTEUGIiQs0F5QcIGowK7HmswYBYs3owXYSlHC5hbWofq2kXhHaleAVBzYQR1eTcPUtqJ0ecDjLqW/qBkqg1M0S40jsZM/pqYy47Nkk8biuzQ==]

Republican voter suppression efforts—from Florida to Georgia to Texas—are rooted in Jim Crow–era tactics. They not only target communities of color, but also suppress the votes of women, people with disabilities, students, and those in poverty.

But Congress has the power to turn back this dark tide. Passing the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act will safeguard our democracy from those who seek to undermine it.

Sign if you agree: Passing the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act will strengthen our democracy. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/john-lewis-voting-rights-advancement-act-petition?contactdata=h/qS1JX8Rly8eETo0exBaM2ncbonKpQhc0POTPpyUONTEUGIiQs0F5QcIGowK7HmswYBYs3owXYSlHC5hbWofq2kXhHaleAVBzYQR1eTcPUtqJ0ecDjLqW/qBkqg1M0S40jsZM/pqYy47Nkk8biuzQ==]

It’s time for Congress to honor the great John Lewis and remove unfair barriers to free and fair elections.

In solidarity,
Ro

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

Unlike most politicians, I refuse to compromise my principles. I’m a Constitutional Absolutist who believes our rights are given to us by our Creator | | | | | [](https://brandonherreraforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f477c278d56293a6a2204057b&id=03c9fc6530&e=3267598119)
---

Friend,

Unlike most politicians, I refuse to compromise my principles.

I’m a Constitutional Absolutist who believes our rights are given to us by our Creator, not granted by the government. In fact, the Constitution restricts the actions and rights of the government, NOT the people.

So, what do I plan to do when I enter Congress?

I’m going to fight like hell to defend those rights and restore our Republic.

**Here are my TOP 4 priorities when I enter Congress.**

But before I share, please consider making a donation to our campaign. I must raise $100,000 before the FEC fundraising deadline on September 30 at 11:59 p.m. Your support, either a generous one-time donation or signing up for a monthly gift, makes a BIG impact on our ability to reach voters and WIN this election.

[**Click here to donate $10, $20.24, $100, $250, $500, or ANY amount before my FEC deadline!**](https://brandonherreraforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f477c278d56293a6a2204057b&id=d0cf40a6ad&e=3267598119)
| [Donate](https://brandonherreraforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f477c278d56293a6a2204057b&id=469f73c0c1&e=3267598119)
---
**Here are my Top 4 Issues:**

**Gun Rights**

Shocker, right?

It’s no secret I am a Second Amendment absolutist and will do everything in my power to abolish the ATF and go on offense for our gun rights - unlike my opponent, Tony Gonzales, who voted in favor of Joe Biden’s gun control.

My campaign will hold politicians like Tony accountable for his actions against the Second Amendment.
| [Donate](https://brandonherreraforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f477c278d56293a6a2204057b&id=6b7a9b9e7a&e=3267598119)
---
**Border Security**

The job of the federal government is to protect its citizens first. What is happening on our southern border is not only intentional, but it’s criminal.

While Tony Gonzales advocates for amnesty and the federal government interferes with Texas’s efforts to secure our border, I will demand stronger border security and END the flood of illegal immigration into our lands.
| [Donate](https://brandonherreraforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f477c278d56293a6a2204057b&id=379bf046b6&e=3267598119)
---
**Big Tech Censorship**

Censoring the free exchange of ideas goes against the very essence of this nation’s foundation.

We must stop censorship, whether it comes from government agencies investigating law-abiding citizens over political expression or Silicon Valley technocrats trying to shape the world to their biases.
| [Donate](https://brandonherreraforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f477c278d56293a6a2204057b&id=2836ee1ead&e=3267598119)
---
**School Choice**

The public education system is fundamentally broken. In many cases, it has become a propaganda arm to indoctrinate your children with anti-American and anti-family values.

The public schooling system should not have a federally enforced monopoly on your children's education. That is why I am an advocate for School choice.

Let’s abolish the Department of Education!

**I promise to do everything in my power to fight for these issues and abide by the Constitution once I’m in Congress. You have my word** on that.
|
---
And there you have it! Those are my TOP 4 priorities when I enter Congress.

As a reminder, I have my end-of-quarter FEC fundraising goal of $100,000 with a Sept. 30th 11:59 p.m. deadline. It would mean the world to me if you would consider making a donation.

My other goal is to recruit 1,000 supporters to make a MONTHLY gift.

Please consider taking action by using one of the links below.

Something those workers said that really stuck with me was, “They got a bailout while we got sold out.” As President Biden pointed out yesterday, the UAW made huge concessions to save the auto industry when it was going under. Now that it's roaring back, workers deserve to benefit – not just the executives.
The best way for workers to get a fair deal for their labor has been and will always be through the awesome power of a union. To protect that right, we need to pass the Richard Trumka PRO Act, which would strengthen and modernize our laws to support workers who want to unionize.
But under a Republican-controlled House, the PRO Act will never reach the floor for a vote. **Too many of them are beholden to the corporate donors who line their campaign coffers. That's why – unlike our current congressman, Brian Fitzpatrick – I don't take a CENT from corporate PACs.**

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

clean_body: Trump's far-right majority on the Supreme Court | | | BREAKING NEWS: The Supreme Court agrees to hear a case that could END Social Security! Friend, Republicans have spent years scheming to destroy Social Security. And now, Trump's far-right majority on the Supreme Court could be preparing to OVERTURN this critical legislation. Over the past 88 years, Social Security has helped hundreds of millions of Americans pay their bills and retire with dignity. Today, 67 million people receive benefits — that's 1 in every 5 Americans! Social Security is, without a doubt, one of the most important — and popular — pieces of legislation ever passed. But now, the future of this vital program rests in the hands of far-right radicals on the Supreme Court. These extremists have already made it clear that they have no respect for precedent or the will of the American people. We cannot sit on the sidelines and watch as they strip away our benefits.We have to make our voices heard NOW. Please, respond before 11:59 p.m. tonight to tell us: Should the Supreme Court Protect Social Security? | | | | | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. | | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

Last weekend, I had the pleasure of introducing Laura and Joel Brady at the grand opening of their new art studio and gallery in Allentown. The [Laura Brady Gallery](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=10e1e5d670&e=1090c5c412) is a beautiful place, full of her paintings of nature, adding to the robust arts and culture scene that keeps getting better in the greater Lehigh Valley.

For Laura and Joel, the gallery is more than an artistic endeavor. It’s also a business. Our community is fortunate that they decided to start and grow their business here instead of somewhere else.

Being a small business owner is hard, and taking the first step can be daunting. I remember when my wife Susan and I started our own business 18 years ago. I worried that if I made a mistake, I might lose our house. Together, Susan and I worked long hours and overcame significant obstacles to build a thriving business. It was a rollercoaster ride, but it was worth it.

Today, it’s much harder to succeed. That’s because Joe Biden and Susan Wild have delivered persistent inflation, stifling regulations, and punishing interest rates, which are suffocating the small business sector. The Russell 2000, America’s leading index of small public companies, is down 11% since July.

To turn this around, we need a leadership change in Washington. We must cut wasteful spending to tame inflation, reduce red tape to unleash entrepreneurs, and stop forcing small business owners to be the nation’s piggybank for progressive priorities.

I’m confident that Laura and Joel will succeed because they are faithful and smart and provide wonderful paintings that people enjoy. Let’s help them and other entrepreneurs spend less time filling out forms, hedging their bets, and paying their taxes, and more time providing great products to their customers.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 40 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life. _

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| Peter,

As President Biden heads to Michigan to stand with United Auto Workers striking for fair wages and better benefits, I’d like to take a moment to extend my solidarity.

The right to a minimum wage, workers' compensation, and protections from discrimination and harassment in the workplace have their roots in our nation’s labor movements.

Each and every day, I am inspired to action by workers across the country demanding their fair share. Millions of workers are seeing the impacts of rising costs and stagnant wages, and it demands urgent attention.

I am proud to be a founding member of the Labor Caucus and a former card-carrying union member myself. As your Congresswoman, I’m working every day to improve working conditions and protect workers’ rights in our community and across the country.

In solidarity,

Linda

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Washington State Republican Party
body:
These are the 37 School Board races to keep an eye on during the 2023 local elections in Washington State... | | | [ ](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=4b038f65f3&e=6a281f566d)

| | Dear Republicans,

There are thousands of local elections happening across Washington State **this year**. Mayors, city councils, school boards—most are non-partisan. It can be tough to tell who’s who in these races or what the various candidates mean for our schools, cities and state moving forward.

The WAGOP has released a **spotlight list of 37 c****ommon-sense conservative school board candidates** to keep your eye on this November. The outcomes of their races can give us an indication of how our conservative message is working in WA communities.

**These are the****37 school board races that pundits refer to as "bellwether" races**. Based on political-lean, geography, and impact on future races, the outcome of these races can help predict the future of Washington State's political direction and the movement our Republican Party is making.

These bellwether races are listed below, arranged by county location—so you can find the races closest to you. **Click on the buttons below to** **learn more about these important campaigns** either from their campaign website, or from the county GOP website (not all local campaigns will host a campaign website).**** You’ll find candidate information, campaign event schedules, volunteer opportunities, and **contribution links****.**

That last part is critical.**Please contribute to these great school board candidates.** Any amount helps. Your dollars go a long way in local races. You can**help these candidates finish strong** , as ballots are being mailed out. Help them print fliers, mail post cards, buy newspaper or radio ads and organize doorbelling efforts.
_Please also look at your county GOP websites for more voting recommendations on other races in your hometown._

Derek, You probably saw that Mitch McConnell’s hand-picked candidate launched his campaign for Pennsylvania’s Senate seat this week — and that he’s a mega-millionaire hedge fund executive who could self-fund a race. Pennsylvanians deserve a Senator who supports our unions and strengthens workers’ rights, not one who made his fortune selling out Pennsylvanian and American workers to China. **Pennsylvanians deserve a Senator who will fight for their bottom line, not powerful special interests.** Pennsylvanians deserve a Senator who is on their side, not someone who is out for themselves at any cost. body:
On Mon, Sept 25, 2023 Andrea Salinas wrote:
Team – We just want to bump this email for you.
We’re up against a huge end-of-quarter deadline on September 30th – **only the 3rd FEC end-of-quarter deadline of the re-election campaign** – and, where things stand right now, we’re not on track to meet our must-hit goal.

Posting a strong fundraising report is absolutely essential to showcasing the strength of our campaign and proving that Andrea has what it takes to win again next year.

body:
We're getting down to the wire, and there's so much at stake. | Hey Derek,

Can you believe in just over one month, Kentuckians will once again head to the polls and make their voices heard about who they want to lead our Commonwealth for the next four years?

We're getting down to the wire, and there's so much at stake. I'm up against Daniel Cameron – Mitch McConnell's protégé who wants to take millions away from public schools, roll back health care access, and so much more. Cameron is too extreme for Kentucky. We can't allow him to drag us backward.

But here's the truth: the work we put in over the next few weeks will make all the difference on November 7. Cameron and his allies are spending millions to attack me, and _Politico_ is calling this matchup "dramatically close."

We need to keep our foot on the gas from now until Election Day to ensure we don't fall behind for even a moment. But we can't do it without your support, Derek.

[** Will you split a donation between my campaign and Tony Evers' team before my final end-of-quarter deadline to help ensure my team and I have the resources necessary to defeat Cameron and protect Kentucky's progress?**](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2154?amount=10&refcode=EM_NBI_TE_20230926_FR_eoq_0_3MO_AndyBeshear_AndyBeshear_NA_eoq.2.9&t=5&akid=6403%2E1827488%2EwYYUQt)

Thank you for having my back,

Andy

Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.
