| Peter -
With the end-of-month and quarterly fundraising deadline approaching at the end of this week, your inbox is about to be flooded with politicians asking for money.
You're going to see a lot of scare tactics from both sides about how, if you'd only send them $5, then America will be saved from the brink of collapse. I'm sure it gets overwhelming and that you are tired of seeing the same hyperbolic rhetoric fill your email inbox, especially at the end of the month.
Rarely do people asking for money tell you exactly how your donations will help their campaigns and what they actually use your money for. So, I'm going to tell you how your donations help my campaign.
PROMOTING THE CONSERVATIVE MESSAGE: For conservatives to promote our message and values on key policy issues and debates, we must inform people with compelling content. I regularly produce and post persuasive videos to millions of people on social media and through other mediums on some of the most pressing issues facing America - like border security, debunking false narratives about climate change, and why the conservative governing philosophy is best suited for prosperity. Producing and getting these videos out to as many people as possible takes resources, resources that I would not have without your help.
INCREASING VOTER TURNOUT IN THE REPUBLICAN PRIMARIES: In some of the most critical swing districts, low voter turnout in Republican primaries has led to unqualified candidates securing the GOP nomination, only to go on to lose the general election to a Democrat. We all know examples from the last election cycle of good pickup opportunities that were lost because too many conservatives stayed home during the primaries. Democrats poured millions of dollars into many of those GOP primary races with the intention of nominating the worst candidates. Which is why I am putting a strong emphasis on increasing voter turnout in GOP primaries so that we nominate candidates who will dominate in the November election. Door knocking, phone banking, voter registration drives, volunteer recruitment, social media campaigns, and much more. We have got to beat the Democrats at their own ground game.
HELPING CONSERVATIVES WIN UP AND DOWN THE BALLOT: Holding the Republican majority in the House, retaking the Senate, and helping conservatives up and down the ballot is a responsibility I take very seriously. I travel the country campaigning for conservatives, assisting in their messaging, and helping make sure they have what they need to win. When you send your hard-earned money to my campaign, you're also helping Republicans gain and sustain governing majorities at all levels of America's government.
RECRUITING YOUNG PEOPLE TO JOIN THE CONSERVATIVE MOVEMENT: Recruiting the next generation of Americans to join our conservative movement is one of my top priorities. One of the best ways I do this is through my Crenshaw Youth Summit and other events I hold throughout the year, specifically geared toward young people. These are fun and informative events with some of the most well-known speakers in America. Thousands of young people attend these events at very low cost, and your donations help ensure we can put on a great event without having to charge an exorbitant amount of money to attend.
This is exactly how I use your donations. No tricks, no gimmicks. Every dollar you send me is put to use advancing your priorities and advancing our conservative movement. And, of course, I would not be able to run for re-election without your help.
I hope this message was informative for you and I hope that you will consider donating at one of the links provided below.

You're going to see a lot of scare tactics from both sides about how, if you'd only send them $5, then America will be saved from the brink of collapse. I'm sure it gets overwhelming and that you are tired of seeing the same hyperbolic rhetoric fill your email inbox, especially at the end of the month. Rarely do people asking for money tell you exactly how your donations will help their campaigns and what they actually use your money for. So, I'm going to tell you how your donations help my campaign. PROMOTING THE CONSERVATIVE MESSAGE: For conservatives to promote our message and values on key policy issues and debates, we must inform people with compelling content. I regularly produce and post persuasive videos to millions of people on social media and through other mediums on some of the most pressing issues facing America - like border security, debunking false narratives about climate change, and why the conservative governing philosophy is best suited for prosperity. Producing and getting these videos out to as many people as possible takes resources, resources that I would not have without your help. INCREASING VOTER TURNOUT IN THE REPUBLICAN PRIMARIES: In some of the most critical swing districts, low voter turnout in Republican primaries has led to unqualified candidates securing the GOP nomination, only to go on to lose the general election to a Democrat. We all know examples from the last election cycle of good pickup opportunities that were lost because too many conservatives stayed home during the primaries. Democrats poured millions of dollars into many of those GOP primary races with the intention of nominating the worst candidates. Which is why I am putting a strong emphasis on increasing voter turnout in GOP primaries so that we nominate candidates who will dominate in the November election. Door knocking, phone banking, voter registration drives, volunteer recruitment, social media campaigns, and much more. We have got to beat the Democrats at their own ground game. HELPING CONSERVATIVES WIN UP AND DOWN THE BALLOT: Holding the Republican majority in the House, retaking the Senate, and helping conservatives up and down the ballot is a responsibility I take very seriously. I travel the country campaigning for conservatives, assisting in their messaging, and helping make sure they have what they need to win. When you send your hard-earned money to my campaign, you're also helping Republicans gain and sustain governing majorities at all levels of America's government. RECRUITING YOUNG PEOPLE TO JOIN THE CONSERVATIVE MOVEMENT: Recruiting the next generation of Americans to join our conservative movement is one of my top priorities. One of the best ways I do this is through my Crenshaw Youth Summit and other events I hold throughout the year, specifically geared toward young people. These are fun and informative events with some of the most well-known speakers in America. Thousands of young people attend these events at very low cost, and your donations help ensure we can put on a great event without having to charge an exorbitant amount of money to attend. This is exactly how I use your donations. No tricks, no gimmicks. Every dollar you send me is put to use advancing your priorities and advancing our conservative movement. Friend,
Can you believe it's been almost three months since I've launched my campaign for US Senate? I want to give you a recap of what we've been up to, and give you an opportunity to chip in toward our very first End of Quarter Fundraising Goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230926_em_fr_b1_KP_3090]
But first: Thank you so much for the time, energy, and support you've given me and my team.
Here's just some of what we've been able to accomplish in the last few months:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230926_em_fr_b1_KP_3090 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230926_em_fr_b1_KP_3090]
JULY: Earlier this summer, we officially launched my campaign for US Senate (this clip is from my launch video ⬆️). Along with almost 30 elected officials and lawmakers, I received overwhelming support from Hoosiers across Indiana.
AUGUST: In our first full month of campaigning, the Indiana GOP cleared the field early on and endorsed extremist Jim Banks in this race – unprecedented and a clear sign to how important this seat is.
SEPTEMBER: This month has been spent meeting folks across the state, getting to know their concerns, and telling them about my plans to expand on our freedoms, not limit them.
Now that September is almost over, we need your help to meet our upcoming goal and ensure that our next finance report is a strong one.
Friend, this is the very first End of Quarter Fundraising Goal of my campaign. We need your help to show journalists, analysts, and the GOP the strength of people-powered, people-funded campaigns like mine. Will you chip in to reach our $8,270 goal before the deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230926_em_fr_b1_KP_3090]
DONATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230926_em_fr_b1_KP_3090]
Thank you,
Keith Potts
Keith Potts was first elected in 2019 to represent District 2 on the Indianapolis City-County Council.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230926_em_fr_b1_KP_3090 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230926_em_fr_b1_KP_3090]
Keith’s political work has been centered on issue-based campaigns and progressive candidates, with a particular focus on protecting women’s rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and the environment.
He is an arts advocate, having graduated in 2012 from the Boston Conservatory of Music with a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree. He works with local non-profit arts organizations, teaching after-school music classes, directing, and performing with organizations like the Phoenix Theatre, Indy Shakes, Indianapolis Chamber Orchestra, Actors Theatre of Indiana, and Civic Theatre. Keith currently lives on the north side of Indianapolis with his husband, Dr. Bryan Dodd, and their rescue dog, Mak.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70412069/429259211/1322170159?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzczOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZjlkNDA0OC1hOTVjLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=692bksl1SVjelGPG3k8RwzDZYmxVnv509Rpu72BHMHs=&emci=fabe2f9b-9e5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=4f9d4048-a95c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=1486204)

| | Hi Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. **When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital.** When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition." Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. **Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the**** _Affordable Care Act_****was passed, many of us could be denied coverage.** Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican mega-donors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter. **[So today, I’m humbly asking: Will you split a donation between my reelection campaign and Gwen Moore to defend our Senate majority and prevent Republicans from rolling back the progress we’ve made expanding access to affordable health care?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70412072/429259212/1470800948?refcode=0926&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzczOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZjlkNDA0OC1hOTVjLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=692bksl1SVjelGPG3k8RwzDZYmxVnv509Rpu72BHMHs=)**

I am not going to let anyone make me forget where I came from or why I got into public service in the first place. My experience has always inspired my work to do everything I can to make sure that every American has quality, affordable health care coverage and stand up against those who want to take it away. So long as you're with me, I know we can overcome any challenge we may face on the road ahead and stop the Republicans from taking away health insurance from millions of Americans once and for all. **[It starts by holding onto the Democratic Senate majority; chip in if you can.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70412077/429259214/1470800948?refcode=0926&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzczOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZjlkNDA0OC1hOTVjLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=692bksl1SVjelGPG3k8RwzDZYmxVnv509Rpu72BHMHs=)** Thank you for standing with me. — Tammy

She served in the Wisconsin State Senate from 1993-2004. Before her election to the Senate, Congresswoman Moore served two consecutive terms in the Wisconsin State Assembly from 1989-92.

clean_body: I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you| | | | | Hi Peter, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition." Peter, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Actwas passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican mega-donors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, Peter. = = I am not going to let anyone make me forget where I came from or why I got into public service in the first place. My experience has always inspired my work to do everything I can to make sure that every American has quality, affordable health care coverage and stand up against those who want to take it away. So long as you're with me, I know we can overcome any challenge we may face on the road ahead and stop the Republicans from taking away health insurance from millions of Americans once and for all. = Thank you for standing with me. — Tammy | | | The first African-American woman in Wisconsin history to serve in the U.S. House of Representatives, Congresswoman Gwen Moore, took her official oath of office on January 4, 2005. She served in the Wisconsin State Senate from 1993-2004. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

I’m getting concerned that you might not understand what is at stake in Arizona.

Democrats know full well that come this time next year, Arizona will be the center of the political universe – much like it has been over the last several cycles. That’s why every Democrat donor in the country is giving generously to my opponent, Ruben Gallego; **last quarter he raised more than $3 million from over 100,000 small-dollar donors**.

As the second GOP debate looms, how can the Republicans keep the momentum going? Virginia House Delegate Nick Freitas and political commentator Liz Wheeler joins me to map out a winning strategy for the GOP. Meanwhile in Washington, the clock ticks as a government shutdown dangles by a thread. And immigration and Eagle Pass take a backseat in the news to Taylor Swift at an NFL game. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Why I’m supporting Summer Lee for re-election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
**I’m beyond excited to support Summer Lee as she launches her campaign for re-election!**
Rep. Summer Lee made history last year when she became the first Black Congresswoman elected in Pennsylvania and beat out millions of dollars in corporate PAC spending against her. Usually in Washington, that level of dark money spent against a member of Congress would result in them shying away or pulling back from fighting for everyday people. But Summer didn’t let private interests slow her down one bit — she got to Washington, preserved her values, and has been fighting for working class people day and night since taking office in January. Now it’s time to ensure she keeps her seat for the people of Western PA.
[Before I go any further about why we need more progressive champions like Summer in the House, can you help us finish this quarter off on a high note by splitting a $5 donation between our campaigns to make sure Summer can continue to fight for working families for another term?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230926-summer._biGJm&refcode=em20230926-5046-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5046%2E2526796%2EEnmwnj)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230926-summer._biGJm&refcode=em20230926-5046-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=5046%2E2526796%2EEnmwnj)**
**So, why am I supporting Summer?**
As a true advocate for the people, **Summer Lee has always taken on big fights against some of the worst corporations putting profits over the lives of people.** Earlier this year, Summer led the call for accountability against Norfolk Southern after the East Palestine train derailment, where thousands of Ohioans were left struggling with environmental injustices in the aftermath of the spill — and she continues that fight today
Summer has also introduced three crucial bills in her short time in office: the Hazard Pay for Health Care Workers Act, the Equality in our Laws Act, and the Bipartisan Abandoned Well Remediation Act, which passed through the Science, Space, and Technology committee with a unanimous, bipartisan vote. She has co-led over a dozen bills, including legislation to make sure billionaires pay their fair share in taxes.
**Summer has accomplished all this in the short 9 months since she took office. Just imagine what we can accomplish together with another term and a Democratic majority!**
Right now, we’re already seeing right-wing billionaire-backed corporate Super PACs pour money into stopping our fight for true multiracial democracy and a united working class in 2024, but we can’t let them win. We’ve beat them before — and let’s do it again.
[ Help us send a STRONG end-of-quarter message by splitting a $5 donation to Summer Lee and our campaign today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230926-summer._biGJm&refcode=em20230926-5046-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=5046%2E2526796%2EEnmwnj)
In gratitude and service,
AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20230926-summer?refcode=em20230926-5046-P_FND_SPL_MIS&t=22&refcode2=5046_2526796_Enmwnj&akid=5046%2E2526796%2EEnmwnj)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20230926-5046-P_FND_SPL_MIS&t=23&akid=5046%2E2526796%2EEnmwnj)**

subject: What do we want? Building up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters
body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/70420047/429270961/-862327480?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk2OGM4YmY0LWIzNWMtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z9pHRh0-9nVNkV856EBsHcfDYH8N1S08q9wm8MPC15k=&emci=38de29e5-ac5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=968c8bf4-b35c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) | | | Dear Peter, For many, finding a place to live is becoming a near-impossible feat. You want to have a quick commute, be in a safe neighborhood, easily access the grocery store, have transportation options, and frequent your favorite places for leisure–all while being able to afford it. **By investing in infrastructure within urban growth boundaries and building densely, we can house people in a safe, climate-friendly, and equitable way without breaking the bank.** This week, the Oregon State Legislature is convening for Legislative Days to hold informational hearings leading up to the 2024 short legislative session. **Both the Senate and House committees on housing are holding hearings to discuss how Oregon will address our housing crisis.**[**Let our lawmakers know that you want to see solutions that address not just housing, but climate change too!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/70420048/429270963/-862327480?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk2OGM4YmY0LWIzNWMtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z9pHRh0-9nVNkV856EBsHcfDYH8N1S08q9wm8MPC15k=&emci=38de29e5-ac5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=968c8bf4-b35c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) At a time when wildfires are getting bigger and more dangerous due to human-caused climate pollution, being safe from fire risk is important. **[Places further outside urban growth boundaries are often at higher wildfire risk than within existing city limits. And, developing raw land is very expensive and time consuming, so let's not expand unnecessarily.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/70420049/429270964/-862327480?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk2OGM4YmY0LWIzNWMtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z9pHRh0-9nVNkV856EBsHcfDYH8N1S08q9wm8MPC15k=&emci=38de29e5-ac5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=968c8bf4-b35c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230)** In cities, there’s land ready for development that just needs infrastructure for sewage, water, electricity, and other services. This land is in close proximity to existing amenities like grocery stores, parks, schools, and libraries, where communities can gather and find relief during extreme weather events. Investing in infrastructure in such urban areas will help increase density in our existing towns and cities, potentially reducing driving and enabling people to quickly get to the places they need for work, play, and rest. [This kind of development would make the most of our undeveloped urban areas while addressing both the housing and climate crises.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/70420050/429270966/-862327480?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk2OGM4YmY0LWIzNWMtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z9pHRh0-9nVNkV856EBsHcfDYH8N1S08q9wm8MPC15k=&emci=38de29e5-ac5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=968c8bf4-b35c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) We all know that humanity is facing a global climate crisis at the same time that Oregon is facing a severe housing crisis. And we all want both resolved as equitably and quickly as possible, but **it’s important that we find (and fund) the right solutions–ones that last.** We shouldn’t be building homes that will need retrofitting or other changes a couple years later, or houses built further out that could eventually burn or force us to stray further from our climate goals by relying on additional driving. [**Write to our lawmakers today, letting them know what you want to see: densely-built cities and towns with affordable housing for all.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/70420051/429270967/-862327480?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk2OGM4YmY0LWIzNWMtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z9pHRh0-9nVNkV856EBsHcfDYH8N1S08q9wm8MPC15k=&emci=38de29e5-ac5c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=968c8bf4-b35c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) Thank you for all that you do,
Julia DeGraw

Coalition Director, OLCV | |

subject: We shouldn’t have to live court case to court case
body:
It’s exhausting living in limbo. | | | Two weeks ago, Judge Hanen ruled against DACA _yet again_ and doubled down on his decision to halt new applications. DACA recipients are, once again, in a state of limbo, and it’s exhausting. That’s not even to mention the millions of immigrant youth who would have been eligible for DACA but can no longer apply. **Immigrant youth are tired of living court case to court case. And it doesn’t need to be this way.** In the weeks and months ahead, we’ll continue to put pressure on members of Congress and the Biden administration to deliver a pathway to citizenship. Congress and Biden promised to protect our communities, and coming up short could have devastating consequences for undocumented communities. This latest decision shows just how important our fight for permanent protections is. DACA was not and will never be more than a temporary solution. We were here long before DACA, and we are here to stay no matter what happens. **Will you add a donation to fuel our fight for permanent protections? clean_body: It’s exhausting living in limbo. | | | Two weeks ago, Judge Hanen ruled against DACA yet again and doubled down on his decision to halt new applications. DACA recipients are, once again, in a state of limbo, and it’s exhausting. That’s not even to mention the millions of immigrant youth who would have been eligible for DACA but can no longer apply. Immigrant youth are tired of living court case to court case. And it doesn’t need to be this way. In the weeks and months ahead, we’ll continue to put pressure on members of Congress and the Biden administration to deliver a pathway to citizenship. Congress and Biden promised to protect our communities, and coming up short could have devastating consequences for undocumented communities. This latest decision shows just how important our fight for permanent protections is. DACA was not and will never be more than a temporary solution. We were here long before DACA, and we are here to stay no matter what happens. Will you add a donation to fuel our fight for permanent protections? body:
#
Friend – we have a _major deadline_ coming up at the end of the week.

In a moment, [_we are going to ask you to pitch in $5 or more so we can hit our goal,_](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-eoq?amount=10?source=em230921-90do&refcode2=461_8507_OKRrKM&akid=461%2E8507%2EOKRrKM) but first we need to explain why this is so important:
1. **This is an official deadline set by the Federal Election Commission (FEC):** At the end of every quarter, the FEC requires campaigns to submit a fundraising report, which means at midnight on the 30th, we need to close our books.

2. **The FEC report is made public:** Everyone – including George Santos’s team, his special interest donors, and all the politics pundits you can think of – will be pouring through the report looking for weaknesses.

3. **This is a make it or break it moment:** If we hit our goal, we send a message to Democrats across the country that we have truly built a team capable of defeating George Santos! But falling short could spell the beginning of the end for a grassroots campaign.

[We are laying it all on the line, folks:](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-eoq?amount=10?source=em230921-90do&refcode2=461_8507_OKRrKM&akid=461%2E8507%2EOKRrKM) [_Our goal is to hit 1,000 donations before midnight on Saturday! Will you send in your support ASAP so we can get the job done?_](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-eoq?amount=10?source=em230921-90do&refcode2=461_8507_OKRrKM&akid=461%2E8507%2EOKRrKM)

If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Donate $10 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-eoq?amount=10?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=em20230926-el&refcode2=461_8507_OKRrKM&akid=461%2E8507%2EOKRrKM) [Donate $25 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-eoq?amount=10?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=em20230926-el&refcode2=461_8507_OKRrKM&akid=461%2E8507%2EOKRrKM) [Donate $50 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-eoq?amount=10?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=em20230926-el&refcode2=461_8507_OKRrKM&akid=461%2E8507%2EOKRrKM) [Other Amount ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2309-eoq?amount=10&amount=30&refcode=em20230926-el&refcode2=461_8507_OKRrKM&akid=461%2E8507%2EOKRrKM)

We know we can do it!!

Kat Cammack, the youngest Republican woman in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack, now in her second term, sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: MAGA Republicans are holding the government hostage
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Hey friends, it’s Sara Jacobs.
House Republicans are holding our government hostage to shove their right-wing ideology down the throats of the American people and hurtling our country toward an unnecessary government shutdown, with no concerns for the millions of families and workers who will be impacted.
Instead of getting anything of substance accomplished for the American people - like extending funding for key programs that will address issues like child poverty and the child care crisis - the House GOP is in chaos.
Here’s the bottom line: House Republicans can’t govern.
That’s why I’m doing everything in my power to ensure we flip the House in 2024 - that means fending off my MAGA opponent and helping like-minded Democrats win their elections, too. But I’m going to need your help.
As we prepare for the end of the quarter on September 30th, I challenged my team to set a fundraising goal of $4,000 to fund my re-election campaign and ensure that when our finance report is made public, it shows the strength of our grassroots support.
Can you chip in $5, $10, $15, or whatever is meaningful to you before the end of the month? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Look, no matter what happens with this spending bill, these right-wing Members of Congress must be defeated.
National Republicans embraced, platformed, and helped elect these extreme candidates - giving them power when they should have denounced them. And while Trump and his loyalists continue to destroy our democratic norms and institutions in an attempt to grab even more power, we have to fight to hold together the pieces.
It’s disgraceful - and it’s why we need to vote them out in 2024.
We’ve got a lot of work to do if we’re going to run a strong re-election campaign, help support Democrats all across the country, and ultimately defeat my Trump-loving opponent and flip the House next November. But it’s what we have to do if we’re going to make real progress on the things we care about most.
Can I count on your support? Click here to donate a few dollars to my re-election campaign before our end-of-quarter deadline on September 30th. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thanks so much for your support - it means a lot knowing I have you by my side in the weeks and months ahead.
-Sara

Fellow American,

subject: Fox News is attacking Gisele… again.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
#
Derek, the latest Fox News meltdown just went too far.
In the middle of a tirade about John's hoodies + shorts -- ohhh, the horror! 😂 -- one Fox + Friends host said: “Shame on his wife for not telling him to spiff it up.”
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230926-1?refcode=em20230926-1&refcode2=8588_434096_SGxz0Q&akid=8588%2E434096%2ESGxz0Q) _Here they are, mid freak-out 😱_
That's gross + totally sexist. And it's part of a pattern. So every single time Fox News attacks Gisele, we need to show them that they're COMPLETELY crossing the line.
**[Can you make a donation of ANY amount to show your support + help us defend Gisele (and John) against the nonstop attacks from Fox News?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230926-1?refcode=em20230926-1-8588&refcode2=8588_434096_SGxz0Q&akid=8588%2E434096%2ESGxz0Q)**
**[Fight Back: Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230926-1?refcode=em20230926-8588&refcode2=8588_434096_SGxz0Q&akid=8588%2E434096%2ESGxz0Q)**
Seriously -- we've always expected the right wing media to come for John. And they have, relentlessly. That's kind of just part of the deal when you run for Senate (and beat the GOP). But you know what shouldn't be part of the deal? **Absurd, personal attacks on Gisele.**
Gisele is not a U.S. Senator. She's a mom protecting her kids, a spouse by John's side, and a woman who has stepped up in unbelievable ways for her family.
**Attacks on Gisele are bullshit, full stop.**
**[Don't let it slide. Please chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to show Fox News that their sexist BS is waaaay less acceptable than a hoodie on the dais.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230926-1?refcode=em20230926-1-8588&refcode2=8588_434096_SGxz0Q&akid=8588%2E434096%2ESGxz0Q)**

Thank you for having Gisele + John's backs.
-- Team Fetterman

body:
We can’t control what they are planning to do — but we can make sure Pramila and our movement have the tools to fight back and protect our hard-won progress.
#
Peter,
**At the end of this week, our campaign will face a critical — and public — fundraising deadline.** This Saturday marks the end of the third quarter of this year, so our FEC fundraising report will be due and submitted for public review.
In a moment, we'll provide a personal link to ask you to make a contribution to our end-of-quarter fundraising goal of $27,000 before midnight on Friday. If you are short on time, **[please make a contribution here.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/45868?refcode=em20230926-2975&t=1&akid=2975%2E420207%2EDnNgN-)**

Our campaign's fundraising progress is sure to be picked apart by our far-right opponents to determine the strength of our movement. That means we'll need to seize every opportunity between now and the end of the quarter to strengthen our resources and maintain our strong momentum.
**We've already seen how far the right is willing to go to get their way in Congress — and we're certain there will be more antics to come in 2024.** This includes, but is not limited to, No Labels' brazen attempts to undermine Joe Biden, House Republicans holding our economy hostage by refusing to raise the debt ceiling, and Speaker McCarthy's failure to prevent a total government shutdown.

name: Jirair Ratevosian
subject: Verbally assaulted at Pride
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Jirair Ratevosian for Congress
body:
Jirair is running for Congress because there is so much at stake to ensure everyone in our community has equal opportunities and a fair shot to chase their own dream. If you’d like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/zXToNFXV4kioy6WMrocbTQ2?unsubscribedata=v0wHJnPvFPZaZF09sdVfAZj36lpVfKwRA6BMnKCV1uclxrWWq%2Fzf9GtX%2BGNnWII1TDc0J2t%2BKq66mrxRFsH4Gf94RtZRaIMewaseryqWb4O7mLto0KTo6wIA4lLcv8yy%2FAjtroTECK7eOq5vz3M%2B8em7ydVZjCq7XwHwwfE77sYRkM%2FXwMBGJTd%2B1Kj2uY4DZ0GFTj8xFWClxNOgecBsUI2fstcLALHYpHBMAJkAsQL0Mn3n6P1aCzsU%2BYJwi5d8Ulxr8lfjW7JelAg06%2BCG5QPhGwtp71iw0QMU70mCbnNw4HvFxH3GdaYtaRNuW5Y1at8DIGO7mx9UfI9CFe5OumG6AlSIx9Hn2KRahOnJ2tMdFSdp%2FJKgKexT9lEoZ4wKxnG%2B8R0CLawz85m8Z3ZfcT90zUcxWuZrHmrtMPdB2TeEuJy%2FFUBfFgFPcm0%2F9Sqc)
---
| |
---
**Peter — This weekend I went to Burbank Pride where I was verbally assaulted.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70422354/429278487/-377887102?source=JRFC_EM_FR_092623_Pride_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYxNDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmJlZTY1YmItYmI1Yy1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-2w9qPwQ26MDLP-r7zy-i9wvHCkLRndmGPVfib32f58=) You read that right. My fiancé Micheal and I were chatting with community members at my table when a man in a MAGA shirt approached me. I’m the kind of person who loves hearing from people from all walks of life, so I was interested to hear his perspective. **But then he told me that gay Armenians can’t exist and that I should be ashamed of myself.**

I am **_disgusted_** that someone would try to erase my existence. Here’s the thing, Peter: Armenian existence is hanging by a thread due to the genocide in Artsakh. Across the U.S., the queer community, _my community_ , is being targeted by hateful legislation and hate crimes against LGBTQ+ folks are up. I will not stand for bigotry of any kind, and I sure as hell won’t be silenced.

**[This happened at a critical juncture, Peter. Not only is our country at a crossroads, but I’m facing my critical end of month fundraising deadline. With more than 14 candidates in the primary, I need every dollar I can get if I’m going to stand a chance. Will you chip in now to help me continue to fight injustice and make it to Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70422355/429278488/-377887102?source=JRFC_EM_FR_092623_Pride_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYxNDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmJlZTY1YmItYmI1Yy1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-2w9qPwQ26MDLP-r7zy-i9wvHCkLRndmGPVfib32f58=)** | [Help me fight injustice →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/70422356/429278489/-377887102?amount=10&source=JRFC_EM_FR_092623_Pride_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYxNDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmJlZTY1YmItYmI1Yy1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-2w9qPwQ26MDLP-r7zy-i9wvHCkLRndmGPVfib32f58=)
---
Bigots like the one I encountered this weekend can say “gay Armenians” can’t exist all they want. body:

|
Peter, Congress has just four days to avoid a government shutdown.

With time quickly running out, House Republicans have been busy pushing through bills to hinder cars and truck rulemakings and block __climate progress. They've also passed a bill blocking states from setting their own limits on transportation emissions.

With a shutdown now imminent, there's _enormous_ pressure on Congress to reach a deal. MAGA Republicans are using that leverage to push through their pro-polluter agenda. **It 's up to us to make sure that any last-minute funding deals don't increase giveaways to fossil fuels and gut environmental protections.**

[Peter, the stakes here are huge. This will be the biggest environmental showdown this year -- what we all do _right now_ could make or break our environment's future. Renew your LCV membership for $5 now and your donation will be TRIPLE MATCHED to power our campaign >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/x_yzTwzGXEF~)

** **FOR IMMEDIATE REVIEW:**

**Supporter Record:** Peter Willis
**MATCH STATUS:** [_TRIPLE MATCH ACTIVE_](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/x_yzTwzGXEF~)

**Deadline:** 11:59 pm, September 30, 2023
**Fundraising Goal:** $30,000

**STATUS:** [Renew now -- it only takes $5 >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/x_yzTwzGXEF~) |

As you read this, MAGA Republicans are pushing a budget proposal that would put EPA funding at its lowest levels in more than 30 years, slash clean air protections, mandate dirty energy lease sales, cut environmental clean-up programs, and more. It would be an environmental disaster, Peter.

**So with just a few days to strike a funding deal to avert a government shutdown, we need to ensure that people 's -- not polluters' -- voices are heard loud and clear.**

We need phones to be ringing off the hook. We need emails pouring into congressional offices from constituents. We need to rally support for protecting our environment in Washington D.C. and in states and districts across the country.

[The best thing you can do right now is to renew your LCV membership while it will be TRIPLE MATCHED. Right now, all it takes is $5.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/x_yzTwzGXEF~)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Why I’m thanking you for being a part of this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
I just about always sign these with the same message:

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=85%2E4032634%2ExYU_jN)
---
You might have noticed something about these emails that you get from me.

I just about always sign them with the same message: “Thanks for being a part of this.”

And I mean it. I’m deeply grateful that you are a part of this fight. A part of this movement. A part of this campaign.

Whenever I think about all the ways that so many people contribute to this team, I’m in awe — and I’m inspired to stay in the fight.

Whether you knock on doors or share articles about our work, whether you chip in $3 or $30 or $300, whether you joined this team for my first Senate race or you’re all in for this re-election campaign — you are just as much a part of this effort as anyone else.

We make big change by making it together — from creating the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to lowering the cost of hearing aids to putting a new tax on giant corporations (which helped fund our nation’s biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change).

And we’re still building something greater than the sum of its parts. You’re a part of a team that will continue to fight for the bold action that working families need — like a wealth tax, universal child care, a judicial code of ethics, and much more. And part of a team that will continue to win.

As long as we keep fighting side by side. **[Before Saturday’s FEC deadline, can you make a donation of $28 or any amount to help make our public fundraising report as strong as possible? The numbers we release will show the power of the team that we’re all a part of.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/647?amount=28&t=8&akid=85%2E4032634%2ExYU_jN)**

subject: An important signal

body:
| The FEC deadline—our first since attack ads were dropped against Sharice—is approaching in just a few days, and all eyes are on our campaign.

Sharice has become a major target for the NRCC, who have been hitting us with brand new digital ads and a billboard to mislead voters district-wide. They’ve revealed that their path to expanding their House majority runs right through KS-03.

| | Derek, The unfortunate truth is Republicans in the House of Delegates are dead set on rolling back gun safety legislation. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Expanding education freedom,

* ...and so much more.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

body:
# [](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/39?t=1&akid=129%2E1163%2EqXko9s)
Friends,
Lateefah Simon is many things and there are plenty of reasons we need her fighting for us in DC ([**and if you want to help us make that happen we hope you’ll chip in $15!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230926?refcode=em20230926-1&refcode2=129_1163_qXko9s&akid=129%2E1163%2EqXko9s)), but today we want to talk about just ONE cause that has always been a priority for Lateefah: **The rights of women**.
For the past 30 years – since she was a 16-year-old community organizer – Lateefah has fought for the self-determination of women and girls. **When she gets to Congress, she’ll be on the frontlines fighting to protect and expand reproductive freedom.**
__**And on the frontlines is right where we need her.**__
Lateefah will bring our voices with her to Washington so that young people and vulnerable moms know there is someone in Congress looking out for them. Always.
Republicans have shown us that, left unchecked, they are willing to do whatever it takes to strip women of their fundamental rights to bodily autonomy. Having champions – like Lateefah – who have proven that they can win, in that fight for women’s rights is more important now than ever.
**[That’s why we are calling on our top supporters (that's you!) to band together *NOW* to support sending a champion for women’s rights (and an incredibly effective fighter) to represent us in Washington.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230926?refcode=em20230926-1&refcode2=129_1163_qXko9s&akid=129%2E1163%2EqXko9s) **
Lateefah has received national recognition for her advocacy on behalf of marginalized young women — and there is no doubt in our mind that she will spend the next decade continuing that work.
[**Your support is key to funding our winning strategy to send Lateefah to Congress. Our end-of-quarter deadline for our $6,000 goal is only four days away. Will you make a contribution of $15 or more today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230926?refcode=em20230926-1&refcode2=129_1163_qXko9s&akid=129%2E1163%2EqXko9s)

Thank you!
Together,
Team Lateefah for Congress

body:

| | **The GOP has spent decades building state power, gerrymandering districts, and propelling their anti-American agenda across the country.
